killer:a-nurses-calling.summary: You see Survivors who are healing or being healed near you.
facts: You see Survivors healing or being healed within 28/30/32 m.
killer:a-nurses-calling.tip: Pair with Sloppy Butcher so Survivors spend longer healing.

killer:agitation.summary: Carry Survivors to hooks faster, but everyone hears you coming from further away.
facts: While carrying a Survivor you move 14/16/18% faster.
Your Terror Radius grows by +12 m while carrying.
killer:agitation.tip: Great for reaching far hooks before the Survivor wiggles free.

killer:alien-instinct.summary: Each hook reveals the farthest injured Survivor and leaves them unable to hear your Terror Radius.
facts: On hooking a Survivor, you see the farthest injured Survivor for 8 s.
That Survivor becomes Oblivious for 40/50/60 s.
killer:alien-instinct.tip: Go straight to the revealed Survivor while they cannot hear you.

killer:all-shaking-thunder.summary: Dropping from a height gives you a much longer lunge for a short time.
facts: After a fall from a height, it is active for 15/20/25 s.
Your lunge reaches +75% further.
Cool-down: 5 s.
killer:all-shaking-thunder.tip: Strong on maps with many drops; jump down right behind a Survivor.

killer:awakened-awareness.summary: While carrying a Survivor you see others nearby, catching anyone who tries a save.
facts: While carrying, any Survivor within 16/18/20 m shows to you as an aura.
killer:awakened-awareness.tip: Drop the carried Survivor to hit a teammate who comes too close.

killer:bamboozle.summary: Vault faster, and each window you vault gets blocked for Survivors for a while.
facts: Permanent: you vault 5/10/15% faster.
After you vault a window, Survivors cannot use it for 8/12/16 s.
Vaulting it again restarts the block; vaulting another window moves the block there.
Does not apply to vaulting dropped pallets.
killer:bamboozle.tip: Vault the window at a strong loop to force Survivors away from it.

killer:barbecue-and-chilli.summary: After each hook you briefly see Survivors who are far from that hook.
facts: After hooking a Survivor, you see Survivors at least 60/50/40 m from that hook for 5 s.
killer:barbecue-and-chilli.tip: Use the reveal to pick your next target right after a hook.

killer:batteries-included.summary: Near completed generators you move a bit faster, with the boost lingering briefly.
facts: Within 16 m of a completed generator you get +5% Haste.
The boost stays for 1/3/5 s after leaving.
killer:batteries-included.tip: Chase near finished generators to catch Survivors faster.

killer:beast-of-prey.summary: Building Bloodlust during a chase also makes you Undetectable for a while.
facts: When you gain Bloodlust, you are Undetectable for 30/35/40 s.
killer:beast-of-prey.tip: Long chases let you sneak up on the next Survivor after a down.

killer:bitter-murmur.summary: Finished generators reveal nearby Survivors, and the last one reveals everyone.
facts: When a generator is completed, you see Survivors within 20 m of it for 10 s.
When the last generator is completed, you see all Survivors for 16/18/20 s.
killer:bitter-murmur.tip: Go to the revealed Survivors right away, they are often still grouped.

killer:blood-echo.summary: Each hook makes all injured Survivors Exhausted and unable to heal well.
facts: On hooking a Survivor, all injured Survivors become Exhausted and Haemorrhaged for 20/25/30 s.
killer:blood-echo.tip: Pair with injury perks to block exhaustion perks after every hook.

killer:blood-warden.summary: Once a gate is open, one hook in the endgame can trap the remaining Survivors inside.
facts: Activates when any Exit Gate has been opened.
You see Survivors standing in an Exit Gate area.
Once per match, hooking someone while it is active closes off every open Exit Gate for 40/50/60 s.
No Survivor can escape through them during that time.
killer:blood-warden.tip: Hook a Survivor close to the gate to trap their rescuers.

killer:bloodhound.summary: Makes blood pools of injured Survivors easier to see and longer lasting.
facts: Blood pools of injured Survivors are bright red.
They last 2/3/4 s longer.
killer:bloodhound.tip: Use it to keep track of injured Survivors who break line of sight.

killer:brutal-strength.summary: Break walls and pallets and kick generators faster.
facts: Breaking or damaging walls, pallets and generators is 10/15/20% faster.
killer:brutal-strength.tip: Good for Killers who have to break many pallets in chase.

killer:call-of-brine.summary: Kicked generators regress faster and alert you when Survivors hit Good skill checks on them.
facts: After you damage a generator, the effect lasts 90 s on it.
Regression is 130/140/150% of the normal speed.
You see that generator in yellow.
A Good skill check on it gives you a Loud Noise Notification.
killer:call-of-brine.tip: Pair with Pop Goes the Weasel or Eruption for strong slowdown.

killer:celestial-witness.summary: You keep track of the Obsession when they are far away, or a more distant Survivor becomes it.
facts: Every 30 s: if the Obsession is 40 m away from you, you see them for 2/2.5/3 s.
If not, the farthest Survivor becomes the new Obsession.
killer:celestial-witness.tip: Use the reveals to find the Obsession for an early chase.

killer:corrupt-intervention.summary: The three farthest generators are blocked at the start, buying time for your first down.
facts: At the start, the 3 generators farthest from you are blocked for 80/100/120 s.
Ends early as soon as the first Survivor is downed.
killer:corrupt-intervention.tip: Patrol the open generators near you; Survivors will come to them.

killer:coulrophobia.summary: Survivors inside your Terror Radius heal slower and face faster healing skill checks.
facts: In your Terror Radius, all healing is 20/25/30% slower.
Healing skill check needles move +50% faster.
killer:coulrophobia.tip: Stay near injured Survivors to keep their heals slow.

killer:coup-de-grace.summary: Each finished generator gives tokens that extend your next lunges.
facts: +2 Tokens per completed generator; up to 10 Tokens per match.
Your next lunge reaches 70/75/80% further and uses 1 Token.
Holds at most 5 Tokens at a time.
killer:coup-de-grace.tip: Save the long lunge for a Survivor who thinks they are out of reach.

killer:cruel-limits.summary: Every finished generator blocks all windows for Survivors for a short time.
facts: When a generator is completed, all windows are blocked for Survivors for 20/25/30 s.
You see the blocked windows in yellow.
killer:cruel-limits.tip: Start chases at window loops right after a generator pops.

killer:cull-the-weak.summary: Hooking anyone but the Obsession slows the rest of the team, while the Obsession gets faster at saves.
facts: +1 Token per hook on anyone other than the Obsession.
While the Obsession lives, the others repair, heal and sabotage 2/2.5/3% slower per token, capped at 22/27.5/33% (11 Tokens).
The Obsession is not slowed and gets +33% speed at unhooking and healing others.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:cull-the-weak.tip: Leave the Obsession for last to keep the penalty running.

killer:dark-arrogance.summary: You vault windows faster and recover from attacks quicker, but stuns and blinds hurt you more.
facts: Window vaults are 15/20/25% faster.
Recovery after basic attacks is +10% faster.
You recover from pallet stuns 25% slower.
Blinds on you last +25% longer.
killer:dark-arrogance.tip: Use it on Killers who rarely get stunned or blinded.

killer:dark-devotion.summary: Hurting the Obsession moves your Terror Radius onto them and makes you Undetectable.
facts: When the Obsession gets injured, it is active for 35/40/45 s.
Your Terror Radius moves to the Obsession and is set to 40 m.
You are Undetectable.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:dark-devotion.tip: Hit the Obsession near other Survivors to scare them while you sneak up.

killer:darkness-revealed.summary: Opening a locker shows Survivors hiding near any locker on the map.
facts: Searching a locker shows you Survivors within 8 m of any locker for 6/7/8 s.
Cool-down: 30 s.
killer:darkness-revealed.tip: Open a locker on the way to a generator to check for Survivors.

killer:dead-mans-switch.summary: After a hook, the first generator a Survivor lets go of gets blocked for a while.
facts: Triggers after you hook a Survivor.
When a Survivor lets go of a generator for 2 s, the first such generator gets blocked; the block lasts 30/35/40 s.
You see that generator in white.
Cannot trigger again while the previous block is still active.
killer:dead-mans-switch.tip: Pair with Grim Embrace or Pain Resonance for more generator control.

killer:deadlock.summary: Every finished generator blocks the most advanced remaining one for a short time.
facts: When a generator is completed, the generator with the most progress is blocked for 15/20/25 s.
You see the blocked generator in white.
killer:deadlock.tip: Patrol the blocked generator after it reopens; Survivors will return to it.

killer:deathbound.summary: A Survivor who heals another screams and becomes Oblivious when they move away from them.
facts: Triggers when a Survivor heals another for 1 health state.
The healer screams and gives away their position.
The healer is Oblivious when more than 12/8/4 m from the healed Survivor.
The healer sees the healed Survivor's aura while it lasts.
Ends once the healer is hit or otherwise loses a health state.
killer:deathbound.tip: Chase the healer after the scream; they cannot hear you coming.

killer:deerstalker.summary: Survivors who read your aura are revealed to you, and you show yourself to the least-chased Survivor.
facts: When a Survivor reads your aura, you see their aura for the same time.
Every 40/35/30 s, your aura is shown for 4 s to the Survivor with the least total chase time.
killer:deerstalker.tip: Use the reveals to find Survivors running aura perks.

killer:discordance.summary: Generators being repaired by two or more Survivors are marked for you.
facts: Generators within 64/96/128 m with 2 or more Survivors on them show in yellow.
When a generator is first marked, you get a Loud Noise Notification.
The mark lasts 4 s after the generator leaves your range or only 1 Survivor remains.
killer:discordance.tip: Interrupt group repairs early to stop fast generators.

killer:dissolution.summary: After you hit a Survivor, the next pallet they fast-vault near you breaks instantly.
facts: Activates 3 s after hurting a Survivor with a basic attack; lasts 13/14/15 s.
The next pallet that Survivor fast-vaults inside your Terror Radius breaks at once.
killer:dissolution.tip: Pressure the injured Survivor right away to make them vault a pallet.

killer:distressing.summary: Your Terror Radius grows larger, and Survivors inside it repair more slowly.
facts: Permanent: Terror Radius +30%.
Generator repairs by Survivors inside your Terror Radius are 6/7/8% slower.
killer:distressing.tip: Pair with Terror Radius perks like Coulrophobia or Overcharge.

killer:dominance.summary: The first Survivor to touch each totem makes it blocked, screams and is revealed to you.
facts: Triggers the first time a Survivor interacts with each totem.
The Entity blocks that totem for 25 s; you see it in white.
The Survivor screams.
You see that Survivor's aura for 3/4/5 s.
killer:dominance.tip: Run it with Hex perks so cleansing attempts give you a free chase.

killer:dragons-grip.summary: After you kick a generator, the next Survivor who touches it screams and becomes Exposed.
facts: Active for 30 s after you damage a generator.
The first Survivor to interact with it screams and shows their location for 4 s.
That Survivor is Exposed for 60 s.
Cool-down: 60/45/30 s.
killer:dragons-grip.tip: Kick a generator and wait nearby to punish whoever returns to it.

killer:dying-light.summary: Hooking anyone but the Obsession slows the rest of the team, while the Obsession gets faster at saves.
facts: +1 Token per hook on anyone other than the Obsession.
While the Obsession lives, the others repair, heal and sabotage 2/2.5/3% slower per token, capped at 22/27.5/33% (11 Tokens).
The Obsession is not slowed and gets +33% speed at unhooking and healing others.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:dying-light.tip: Leave the Obsession for last to keep the penalty running.

killer:enduring.summary: Pallet stuns hit you for a much shorter time, so chases keep going.
facts: Pallet stuns on you are 40/45/50% shorter.
Does not apply to stuns while you carry a Survivor.
killer:enduring.tip: Pair with Spirit Fury to punish Survivors who drop pallets early.

killer:eruption.summary: Kicked generators are marked, and each down makes them explode and expose the Survivors on them.
facts: Generators you damage are marked for you in yellow.
When any Survivor is downed, all marked generators explode, losing 10% of total progress at once.
They then keep regressing.
Anyone repairing them screams, and you see them for 8/10/12 s.
Cool-down: 30 s after it fires, which also clears the marks.
killer:eruption.tip: Kick many generators during chases so each down hits several at once.

killer:fire-up.summary: Every finished generator makes many of your actions faster, up to a big late-game boost.
facts: +1 Token per completed generator; max 5 Tokens.
Per token, 6/7/8% faster at the actions below, up to 30/35/40%:
picking up and dropping Survivors;
breaking walls and dropped pallets;
damaging generators;
vaulting windows.
killer:fire-up.tip: It gets stronger as the match goes on, so it helps you catch up late.

killer:forced-hesitation.summary: Downing a Survivor slows everyone near them, making saves and escapes harder.
facts: When a Survivor is downed in any way, other Survivors within 16 m are Hindered by -20% for 10 s.
Cool-down: 40/35/30 s.
killer:forced-hesitation.tip: Down Survivors near their teammates to catch a second one quickly.

killer:forced-penance.summary: Survivors who take a protection hit for someone become Broken for a while.
facts: A Survivor who triggers a Protection Hit is Broken for 60/70/80 s.
killer:forced-penance.tip: Hit the Survivor who body-blocks; they cannot be healed afterwards.

killer:forever-entwined.summary: Each time a Survivor is hit, you get faster at picking up, dropping and hooking.
facts: +1 Token whenever a Survivor takes damage; max 6/7/8 Tokens.
+4% per token to picking up, dropping and hooking Survivors, up to 24/28/32%.
killer:forever-entwined.tip: Faster pick-ups make flashlight and pallet saves harder.

killer:franklins-demise.summary: Your basic attacks knock items out of Survivors' hands, and you see the dropped items.
facts: Survivors hit by your basic attack drop their item.
You see dropped items within 32/48/64 m.
killer:franklins-demise.tip: Good against teams that rely on flashlights and Med-Kits.

killer:friends-til-the-end.summary: Hooking others exposes the Obsession, and hooking the Obsession picks a new one.
facts: Hooking anyone but the Obsession: you see the Obsession for 6/8/10 s.
The Obsession is then Exposed for 20 s.
Hooking the Obsession: a random Survivor screams, shows their location and becomes the new Obsession.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:friends-til-the-end.tip: Rush to the Obsession after each hook to use the Exposed window.

killer:funny-business.summary: Kicking a generator gives you speed and one random extra effect, good or bad.
facts: Each generator kick gives +10% Haste for 10 s plus one random outcome:
the Haste lasts 5 s longer;
you are stunned for 2 s;
the generator is blocked for 30 s;
confetti only, with no effect.
killer:funny-business.tip: Kick generators on your way to a chase to use the speed.

killer:furtive-chase.summary: Hooking the Obsession makes you fast and Undetectable, and their rescuer becomes the new Obsession.
facts: After hooking the Obsession, for 14/16/18 s: Undetectable and +10% Haste.
When another Survivor unhooks the Obsession, the rescuer becomes the Obsession.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:furtive-chase.tip: Chase the rescuer next, they will often be the new Obsession.

killer:game-afoot.summary: Hitting the Survivor who has been chased longest makes them your Obsession, and breaking things in chase speeds you up.
facts: A basic attack on the Survivor with the most total chase time makes them the Obsession.
While chasing the Obsession, breaking or damaging something gives +10% Haste for 8/9/10 s.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:game-afoot.tip: Pair with Brutal Strength to break pallets fast during chases.

killer:gearhead.summary: After a Survivor is hit, Good skill checks on generators reveal who is repairing.
facts: Active for 30 s after any Survivor loses a health state.
A Good repair skill check by a Survivor reveals them for 6/7/8 s.
killer:gearhead.tip: Hit a Survivor, then go to the revealed generator for a new chase.

killer:genetic-limits.summary: Losing a health state makes a Survivor Exhausted for a short time.
facts: Any Survivor who drops a health state becomes Exhausted for 6/7/8 s.
killer:genetic-limits.tip: Blocks the speed burst from Sprint Burst or Lithe right after a hit.

killer:grim-embrace.summary: First hooks on each Survivor block all generators briefly, and the fourth gives a long block.
facts: +1 Token for each Survivor hooked for the first time.
It fires when you are 16 m or more away from the hook.
1-3 Tokens: all generators are blocked for 6/8/10 s.
4 Tokens: all generators are blocked for 40 s and you see the Obsession for 6 s.
killer:grim-embrace.tip: Spread your hooks over all four Survivors for the full effect.

killer:haywire.summary: Exit gates that Survivors leave almost open start closing again.
facts: If a Survivor stops opening a gate after reaching 80% progress, the gate regresses.
It regresses at 80/90/100% of normal opening speed.
The switch lights flicker while it regresses.
killer:haywire.tip: Interrupt gate openers late; the gate will start going back.

killer:help-wanted.summary: Kicked generators become compromised; when one is finished, you recover faster and idle generators regress.
facts: Damaging a generator makes it Compromised; up to 3 at a time.
You see Compromised generators in yellow.
When a Compromised generator is completed, for 70/80/90 s:
your basic attack recovery is +25% faster;
generators no one is working on regress at 150% of normal speed.
Afterwards no generator is Compromised any more.
killer:help-wanted.tip: Kick generators you cannot defend, so finishing one hurts the Survivors.

killer:hex-blood-favour.summary: A Hex that locks pallets near a Survivor you hit, so they cannot drop them.
facts: A Hex Totem is lit at the start of the match.
When a basic attack takes a health state, pallets within 32 m of that Survivor are blocked for 13/14/15 s.
No Survivor can drop blocked pallets.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-blood-favour.tip: Hit Survivors near pallet loops so they have nowhere safe to run.

killer:hex-crowd-control.summary: A Hex that blocks windows Survivors fast-vault, cutting off strong loops.
facts: Lights on a random totem when a Survivor fast-vaults a window.
That window is blocked for all Survivors.
Blocked windows: your normal vault over them is 15% faster.
You see blocked windows within 24 m.
Affects 4/5/6 windows at a time.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-crowd-control.tip: Push Survivors to vault strong windows so they become blocked.

killer:hex-devour-hope.summary: A Hex that grows stronger when Survivors are rescued far from you, ending with instant kills.
facts: A Hex Totem is lit at the start of the match.
+1 Token for each unhook that happens 24 m or more away from you; max 5 Tokens.
2 Tokens: 10 s after hooking, you get 3/4/5% Haste for 10 s.
3 Tokens: all Survivors are Exposed.
5 Tokens: you can kill downed Survivors yourself.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-devour-hope.tip: Leave the hook quickly so rescues happen far away from you.

killer:hex-face-the-darkness.summary: Injuring a Survivor lights a Hex that makes everyone far away scream and reveal themselves.
facts: Needs a Dull Totem on the map; lights a Hex when you injure a Survivor, cursing them.
While cursed, every 35/30/25 s all other Survivors outside your Terror Radius scream.
You see their auras for 2 s.
Ends when the cursed Survivor is healed or downed, which also puts out the totem.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-face-the-darkness.tip: Keep the cursed Survivor injured to keep the screams going.

killer:hex-fortunes-fool.summary: Your first hook on a Survivor lights a Hex that makes them Oblivious and protects the totem for a while.
facts: Needs a Dull Totem; your first hook on a Survivor lights a Hex that curses them.
The cursed Survivor is Oblivious.
For 90 s nobody else can cleanse or bless the totem, since it is blocked.
The cursed Survivor is not blocked.
The cursed Survivor sees the totem within 24/20/16 m.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-fortunes-fool.tip: Patrol near the totem; the cursed Survivor will try to cleanse it.

killer:hex-haunted-ground.summary: Two trap totems: cleansing either one makes all Survivors Exposed for a while.
facts: 2 Hex Totems light when the match begins.
Blessing or cleansing either one makes all Survivors Exposed for 40/50/60 s.
The other Hex Totem goes out after the trap triggers.
Disabled for the rest of the match after it triggers.
killer:hex-haunted-ground.tip: Stay in a chase when the trap goes off to get a quick down.

killer:hex-hive-mind.summary: After your first hook, you see generator progress, and the fourth finished generator punishes the rest.
facts: Your first hook turns a random remaining Dull Totem into its Hex Totem.
You see generators, brighter the more progress they have.
When 4 generators in total are completed, all others explode, lose 6/8/10% progress and start regressing.
The totem then becomes dull and the perk turns off for the match.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-hive-mind.tip: Use the brightness to defend the generators closest to completion.

killer:hex-huntress-lullaby.summary: A Hex that makes failed skill checks hurt more and, with tokens, removes the skill-check warning sound.
facts: Survivors healing or repairing lose 2/4/6% more progress on failed skill checks.
+1 Token per Survivor hooked; max 5 Tokens.
Time between the warning sound and the skill check shrinks: 1 Token -14%, 2 -28%, 3 -42%, 4 -56%.
At 5 Tokens there is no warning sound at all.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-huntress-lullaby.tip: Pair with skill-check perks like Overcharge or Unnerving Presence.

killer:hex-no-one-escapes-death.summary: When the gates get power, a Hex makes every Survivor Exposed and you slightly faster.
facts: When the Exit Gates get power, it lights a remaining Dull Totem.
You get 2/3/4% Haste.
All Survivors are Exposed.
Once Survivors are told about it, they see the totem within 4 m, growing to 24 m over 30 s.
Does nothing if no Dull Totem is left.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-no-one-escapes-death.tip: Do not cleanse totems yourself early; leave Dull Totems for the endgame.

killer:hex-nothing-but-misery.summary: After a few hits a Hex lights that slows down and hampers each Survivor you hit.
facts: Once you land 4 basic-attack hits in total, a random Dull Totem lights as its Hex, cursing every Survivor.
Survivors hit by a basic attack are Hindered by -5% for 10/12.5/15 s.
They also vault 10% slower for 10/12.5/15 s.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-nothing-but-misery.tip: Keep chasing after a hit; the Survivor cannot vault away as fast.

killer:hex-overture-of-doom.summary: A Hex curses the farthest generator; Survivors working on it trigger your Terror Radius there while you sneak.
facts: The Hex Totem curses the generator farthest from it, shown to you in yellow.
When a Survivor repairs it for at least 5 s, for 20/25/30 s:
your Terror Radius moves to that generator and is set to 32 m;
you are Undetectable.
When that generator is done, the next farthest one is cursed.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-overture-of-doom.tip: Go to the cursed generator while Undetectable to surprise the Survivors there.

killer:hex-pentimento.summary: Bring cleansed totems back to life to stack heavy slowdown on healing and repairing.
facts: You see cleansed totems in white.
Press Interaction at a cleansed totem to make it a Rekindled Totem.
+1 Token per Rekindled Totem; max 5 Tokens.
1 Token: healing and repairing are 20% slower.
2 to 5 Tokens: the penalty grows by 1/2/3% for each token, capped at 24/28/32%.
Cursed Survivors see Rekindled Totems within 16 m.
At 5 Tokens, all Rekindled Totems are blocked for the rest of the match.
A totem can be rekindled once; cleansed Rekindled Totems are gone for good.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-pentimento.tip: Rekindle totems when Survivors cleanse fast, then stack tokens over the match.

killer:hex-plaything.summary: Your first hook on a Survivor lights a Hex that makes them Oblivious and protects the totem for a while.
facts: Needs a Dull Totem; your first hook on a Survivor lights a Hex that curses them.
The cursed Survivor is Oblivious.
For 90 s nobody else can cleanse or bless the totem, since it is blocked.
The cursed Survivor is not blocked.
The cursed Survivor sees the totem within 24/20/16 m.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-plaything.tip: Patrol near the totem; the cursed Survivor will try to cleanse it.

killer:hex-retribution.summary: Survivors who touch totems become Oblivious, and losing any Hex reveals the whole team.
facts: Any Survivor who cleanses or blesses a totem turns Oblivious for 40/50/60 s.
When any Hex Totem is removed, including this one, you see all Survivors for 20 s.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-retribution.tip: Pair with other Hex perks so each lost totem still gives you something.

killer:hex-ruin.summary: A Hex that makes every generator nobody is working on lose progress by itself.
facts: Unattended generators lose progress by themselves, at 100/125/150% of normal regression.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-ruin.tip: Pressure Survivors off generators so the regression can work.

killer:hex-scared-to-death.summary: After hooking three different Survivors, breaking pallets in chase makes nearby Survivors scream and slows them.
facts: Lights on a random Dull Totem once you have hooked 3 different Survivors.
Breaking a pallet normally during a chase makes Survivors within 13 m scream.
They are Hindered by -11/-12/-13% for 3 s.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-scared-to-death.tip: Break pallets quickly in chase to catch the slowed Survivor.

killer:hex-the-third-seal.summary: The last few Survivors you hit lose all aura reading while the Hex stands.
facts: Your 2/3/4 most recently hit Survivors (any basic or special attack) stay Blind permanently.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-the-third-seal.tip: Strong against teams using Kindred or Bond for teamwork.

killer:hex-thrill-of-the-hunt.summary: Each lit Hex Totem adds a token; hooking a Survivor then blocks all totems for a while.
facts: Needs a Dull Totem; your first hook on a Survivor lights its Hex, cursing them.
+1 token for each lit Hex Totem on the map.
Each hook blocks all totems for 4/5/6 s per token, up to 20/25/30 s.
Loses 1 Token when a Hex Totem is cleansed.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-thrill-of-the-hunt.tip: Run it with several other Hex perks to protect them all.

killer:hex-two-can-play.summary: After being stunned or blinded a few times, a Hex blinds every Survivor who does it again.

Needs at least one Dull Totem and no totem of its own yet.
Any Survivor who then stuns or blinds you is blinded in turn for 1.5 s.
Does not affect Survivors you carry.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-two-can-play.tip: Good against teams that rely on flashlight and pallet saves.

killer:hex-under-your-thumb.summary: A Hex that caps how much Haste Survivors can gain and reveals those who get it.
facts: Lights on a random Dull Totem when a Survivor gets a hook state.
Haste on running Survivors is capped at 25/20/15%.
When a running Survivor within 32 m gains Haste, you see their location for 4 s.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-under-your-thumb.tip: Strong against Sprint Burst and other speed perks.

killer:hex-undying.summary: Protects your other Hexes by moving them onto this totem when cleansed, and shows Survivors near Dull Totems.
facts: Survivors within 2/3/4 m of a Dull Totem show to you while they stay that close.
When another Hex Totem is cleansed, that Hex moves to the Undying totem and replaces it.
Ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-undying.tip: Pair with a strong Hex like Devour Hope or Ruin.

killer:hex-wretched-fate.summary: After a generator is done, a Hex curses the Obsession and slows their repairs a lot.
facts: After a generator is completed, a random Dull Totem lights and curses the Obsession.
The Obsession repairs 27/30/33% slower.
The Obsession sees the Hex Totem within 12 m.
killer:hex-wretched-fate.tip: Pressure the Obsession so they do not have time to cleanse the totem.

killer:hoarder.summary: Alerts you when Survivors open chests or pick up items near you, and adds extra chests.
facts: Within 32/48/64 m, a Survivor opening a chest or picking up an item alerts you with a 4 s Loud Noise Notification.
2 extra chests appear in the match.
killer:hoarder.tip: Patrol chest-heavy areas early to catch looting Survivors.

killer:hubris.summary: Any Survivor who stuns you becomes Exposed for a while.
facts: When a Survivor stuns you in any way, they are Exposed for 20/25/30 s.
Cool-down: 20 s.
killer:hubris.tip: Chase the stunning Survivor right away for a quick down.

killer:human-greed.summary: You can close opened chests and see unopened ones, revealing Survivors who come near them.

You always see unopened chests.
A Survivor coming within 8 m of a closed or unopened chest is revealed for 3/4/5 s.
Cool-down: 10 s on kicking chests.
killer:human-greed.tip: Close chests on your patrol to catch Survivors looking for items.

killer:hysteria.summary: Injuring a healthy Survivor makes every injured Survivor Oblivious for a while.
facts: When you injure a healthy Survivor, all injured Survivors are Oblivious for 30/35/40 s.

Cool-down: 20 s.
killer:hysteria.tip: Spread injuries so many Survivors cannot hear you coming.

killer:im-all-ears.summary: Survivors fast-vaulting near you are revealed for several seconds.
facts: A fast vault by a Survivor within 48 m shows them to you for 8 s.
Cool-down: 60/45/30 s.
killer:im-all-ears.tip: Use it to predict which way a Survivor runs after a vault.

killer:insidious.summary: Standing still makes you Undetectable, and it lingers briefly when you move.
facts: After standing still for 2 s, you are Undetectable while you do not move.
It stays for 6/7/8 s after you start moving.
killer:insidious.tip: Wait near a hook or generator for Survivors to come close.

killer:iron-grasp.summary: Carried Survivors push you around less and need more time to wiggle free.
facts: Strafing from their wiggling is 75% weaker.
Wiggling free takes 10/11/12% longer.
killer:iron-grasp.tip: Great for reaching far hooks or the Basement.

killer:iron-maiden.summary: You search lockers faster, and Survivors leaving lockers scream and become Exposed.
facts: Searching an empty locker is 30/40/50% faster.
A Survivor leaving a locker screams and you get a Loud Noise Notification there.
The notification stays for 4 s.
They are Exposed for 30 s.
killer:iron-maiden.tip: Good against Survivors who use Head On or Deception.

killer:keep-them-waiting.summary: Hitting Survivors other than the Obsession shortens your attack cool-down; hitting the Obsession costs tokens.
facts: +1 Token per basic-attack hit on a Survivor who is not the Obsession; max 6/7/8 Tokens.
Hitting the Obsession with any attack removes 2 Tokens.
Each token cuts the cool-down after a hit by 5%, up to 30/35/40%.
Tokens stop changing after the Obsession dies.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:keep-them-waiting.tip: Avoid the Obsession early to stack faster recovery after hits.

killer:kill-spree.summary: Once every Survivor is on second hook and all generators are done, you can kill them yourself.
facts: With every generator done and every Survivor on their second hook stage, you may kill them by your own hand.
While you kill, and for 6/8/10 s after, the Exit Gate switches are blocked.
killer:kill-spree.tip: Spread your hooks evenly to set up the endgame.

killer:knock-out.summary: Survivors who drop a pallet and run off quickly are slowed for a moment.
facts: If a Survivor drops a pallet and moves more than 10 m away within 6 s, with the pallet still standing...
...they are Hindered by -20% for 2/3/4 s.
killer:knock-out.tip: Stand still after a pallet drop to catch the Survivor running off.

killer:languid-touch.summary: Survivors who startle crows near you become Exhausted.
facts: When a Survivor startles a crow within 36 m, they are Exhausted for 6/8/10 s.
Cool-down: 5 s.
killer:languid-touch.tip: Blocks exhaustion perks while you search for Survivors.

killer:laughingstock.summary: Survivors near a completed generator are Exhausted and cannot hear your Terror Radius.
facts: Survivors within 12 m of a completed generator are Exhausted and Oblivious.

killer:lay-waste.summary: Kicking a generator makes it lose progress faster, more so the further along it is.

killer:lay-waste.tip: Kick generators that are almost done.

killer:lethal-pursuer.summary: See all Survivors at the start, and every Survivor aura reveal you get lasts longer.
facts: At the start you see all Survivors for 7/8/9 s.
All Survivor aura reveals to you last +2 s longer.
The extra time also applies to its own reveal.
killer:lethal-pursuer.tip: Pair with other aura perks like Barbecue & Chilli.

killer:leverage.summary: Survivors who unhook someone heal slower for a minute.
facts: After any unhook, the Survivor who did it heals 20/25/30% slower for 60 s.
killer:leverage.tip: Pair with healing slowdown perks like Sloppy Butcher.

killer:lightborn.summary: You cannot be blinded by most light sources, and you see Survivors who try.
facts: Any Survivor attempting a blind on you is revealed for 6/8/10 s.
Flashlights, Flash Grenades, Firecrackers and Blast Mine cannot blind you.
killer:lightborn.tip: Pick it against teams with several flashlights.

killer:machine-learning.summary: Kicked generators become compromised; completing one makes you fast and Undetectable.

You see Compromised generators in yellow.
Finishing a Compromised generator gives you Undetectable and +8% Haste for 40/50/60 s.
Afterwards no generator is Compromised any more.
killer:machine-learning.tip: Use the speed and stealth to start a chase right after the generator pops.

killer:mad-grit.summary: While carrying, missed attacks cost no time and hits pause the carried Survivor's wiggling.
facts: While carrying, missed basic attacks have no cool-down.

killer:mad-grit.tip: Swing at Survivors who come close for a body block.

killer:make-your-choice.summary: Survivors who rescue someone while you are far away scream and become Exposed.
facts: When a Survivor is unhooked while you are more than 32 m away, it triggers.

They are Exposed for 40/50/60 s.
Cool-down: 40/50/60 s.
killer:make-your-choice.tip: Leave the hook quickly, then come back for the Exposed rescuer.

killer:merciless-storm.summary: Generators near completion flood Survivors with skill checks, and one mistake blocks the generator.
facts: Triggers when a generator reaches 90% progress.
Survivors working on it get skill check after skill check until it is done.
If any of them misses a check or stops, the Entity blocks it for 16/18/20 s.
Once per generator per match.
killer:merciless-storm.tip: Pair with Huntress Lullaby to make the skill checks harder.

killer:mindbreaker.summary: Survivors repairing generators are Blind and Exhausted, which blocks their aura reading and sprint perks.
facts: Survivors repairing a generator are Blind and Exhausted.
Both effects stay for 3/4/5 s after they stop.
Does not replace an existing Exhaustion; it pauses its timer instead.
killer:mindbreaker.tip: Strong against Sprint Burst users who sit on generators.

killer:monitor-and-abuse.summary: Your Terror Radius is smaller while you patrol and slightly bigger while you chase.
facts: In a chase your Terror Radius is 5/10/15% bigger.
Outside a chase it is 15/20/25% smaller.
killer:monitor-and-abuse.tip: Approach generators quietly, then start the chase.

killer:nemesis.summary: Survivors who stun or blind you become your Obsession and cannot hear you for a while.
facts: Any other Survivor who blinds you, or uses a pallet or locker to stun you, takes over as Obsession.

You see the new Obsession for 8 s.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:nemesis.tip: Go after the new Obsession right away while they are Oblivious.

killer:no-holds-barred.summary: Every finished generator blocks the most advanced remaining one for a short time.
facts: When a generator is completed, the generator with the most progress is blocked for 15/20/25 s.
You see the blocked generator in white.
killer:no-holds-barred.tip: Patrol the blocked generator after it reopens; Survivors will return to it.

killer:no-quarter.summary: Survivors healing themselves face a stream of skill checks near the end, and one mistake makes them Broken.

The Survivor gets skill check after skill check until the heal is done.
A missed check or stopping makes them Broken for 20/25/30 s.
killer:no-quarter.tip: Strong against Self-Care and Med-Kit heavy teams.

killer:no-way-out.summary: First hooks build tokens; in the endgame the first touch on a gate switch blocks both switches for a while.
facts: +1 Token for each Survivor you hook for the first time.
After the Exit Gates are powered, the first Survivor to use a switch gives you a Loud Noise Notification.
Both switches are then blocked for 12 s.
Each token adds 6/9/12 s, up to 36/48/60 s in total.
killer:no-way-out.tip: Hook every Survivor once to make the endgame block as long as possible.

killer:none-are-free.summary: First hooks build tokens; once all generators are done, windows and pallets are blocked for a while.
facts: +1 Token per Survivor hooked for the first time; max 4 Tokens.
When all generators are completed, all windows and standing pallets are blocked.
Block time is 12/14/16 s per token, up to 48/56/64 s.
killer:none-are-free.tip: Use the endgame window to down Survivors who have nowhere to loop.

killer:nowhere-to-hide.summary: Kicking a generator reveals Survivors hiding close to it.
facts: When you damage a generator, you see all Survivors within 24 m of it for 3/4/5 s.
killer:nowhere-to-hide.tip: Kick generators that Survivors just left to find them nearby.

killer:oppression.summary: Kicking one generator makes several others regress too and gives their repairers a hard skill check.
facts: When you damage a generator, up to 4 other random generators start regressing too.
Survivors working on them get a difficult skill check.
Cool-down: 45/40/35 s.
killer:oppression.tip: Pair with Overcharge and Call of Brine for heavy regression.

killer:overcharge.summary: The next Survivor on a generator you kicked gets a hard skill check, and regression speeds up over time.
facts: After you damage a generator, the next Survivor to touch it gets a difficult skill check.
Failing it costs an extra 2/3/4% of the generator's total progress.
Regression on that generator rises from 85% to 130% of normal over 30 s.
killer:overcharge.tip: Kick generators Survivors are about to return to.

killer:overwhelming-presence.summary: Survivors using items near you become Exhausted, and Exhausted Survivors near you get revealed.
facts: When a Survivor within 32 m starts using an item, they are Exhausted for 15 s.
When a Survivor within 32 m becomes Exhausted, you see the closest Exhausted Survivor for 2/3/4 s.
Cool-down: 25 s.
killer:overwhelming-presence.tip: Good against teams that heal with Med-Kits or repair with Toolboxes.

killer:phantom-fear.summary: Survivors who look at you inside your Terror Radius scream and are revealed briefly.
facts: A Survivor inside your Terror Radius who faces you screams.
You see their aura for 2 s.
Cool-down: 80/70/60 s.
killer:phantom-fear.tip: Approach from the front so Survivors look at you.

killer:play-with-your-food.summary: Letting the Obsession escape chases gives you speed tokens, which attacks use up.
facts: +1 Token when you lose the Obsession in a chase; max 3 Tokens.
Any attack that could hurt a Survivor removes 1 Token.
With at least 1 Token you get 3/4/5% Haste per token, up to 9/12/15%.
Cool-down: 10 s between gaining tokens.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:play-with-your-food.tip: Let the Obsession go a few times early, then use the speed on others.

killer:pop-goes-the-weasel.summary: After a hook, your next generator kick removes a big chunk of progress.

Damaging a generator by hand adds +15% regression, 20% in total.
Turns off after use or when time runs out.
killer:pop-goes-the-weasel.tip: Hook near generators that are almost done.

killer:predator.summary: When a Survivor escapes your chase, you see where they went for a moment.

Cool-down: 60/50/40 s.
killer:predator.tip: Useful for Killers who often lose Survivors at corners.

killer:rampage.summary: Breaking pallets and walls builds tokens that give you speed after being stunned or blinded.
facts: +1 token for each pallet or wall you break normally; max 13.
When blinded or pallet-stunned, you get +1% Haste per token for 13 s.
Cool-down: 30/25/20 s after a blind or stun with at least 1 token.
killer:rampage.tip: Break pallets often to stack tokens for long chases.

killer:rancor.summary: Each finished generator shows all Survivors' locations, and in the endgame you can kill the Obsession.
facts: When a generator is completed, all Survivors scream and give a Loud Noise Notification.
The notification stays 3 s.
The Obsession sees your aura for 5/4/3 s.
When the Exit Gates get power, the Obsession stays Exposed until the match ends.
You can then kill the Obsession up close.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:rancor.tip: Keep the Obsession alive until the gates are powered.

killer:rapid-brutality.summary: You never gain Bloodlust, but every hit gives you a short speed boost.
facts: You cannot gain Bloodlust.
A basic attack hit grants +5% Haste for 8/9/10 s.
killer:rapid-brutality.tip: Use the speed to reach the next Survivor or a new chase.

killer:ravenous.summary: First hooks give speed while carrying and faster hooking; four of them make everyone Exposed.
facts: +1 Token per Survivor hooked for the first time; max 4 Tokens.
Per token: +4% Haste while carrying and +4% hooking speed.
At 4 Tokens all Survivors scream and are Exposed for 80/85/90 s.
killer:ravenous.tip: Spread hooks over all four Survivors to reach the Exposed effect.

killer:remember-me.summary: Hurting the Obsession makes the exit gates take longer to open for everyone else.
facts: +1 Token each time the Obsession is hurt or otherwise drops a health state; max 3/4/5 Tokens.
Each token adds 6 s to gate opening, up to 18/24/30 s extra.
Gates then take up to 38/44/50 s to open.
The Obsession still opens gates in the normal 20 s.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:remember-me.tip: Chase the Obsession during the match, but kill them last.

killer:save-the-best-for-last.summary: Hitting Survivors other than the Obsession shortens your attack cool-down; hitting the Obsession costs tokens.

Tokens stop changing after the Obsession dies.
You have only one Obsession at a time.

killer:scourge-hook-floods-of-rage.summary: Unhooks from Scourge Hooks reveal every other Survivor to you.
facts: 4 hooks become Scourge Hooks when the match starts; you see them in white.
When a Survivor is unhooked from one, you see the other Survivors for 5/6/7 s.
killer:scourge-hook-floods-of-rage.tip: Hook Survivors on Scourge Hooks so rescues give you information.

killer:scourge-hook-gift-of-pain.summary: Survivors unhooked from Scourge Hooks bleed and, once healed, work slower until hurt again.

After their first full heal, they heal and repair 10/13/16% slower until they are injured again.
killer:scourge-hook-gift-of-pain.tip: Pair with healing slowdown so Survivors avoid healing.

killer:scourge-hook-hangmans-trick.summary: While carrying, you see Survivors near Scourge Hooks, and you are alerted when hooks are sabotaged.
facts: 4 hooks become Scourge Hooks when the match starts; you see them in white.
While carrying a Survivor, you see Survivors within 12/14/16 m of a Scourge Hook.
When a Survivor starts sabotaging any hook, you get a Loud Noise Notification there.

killer:scourge-hook-jagged-compass.summary: Normal hooks turn into Scourge Hooks after use, and Scourge hooking shows the best generator.
facts: 4 hooks become Scourge Hooks when the match starts; you see them in white.
Any regular hook someone gets rescued from turns into a Scourge Hook.
Hooking someone on a Scourge Hook highlights the most advanced generator (yellow) for 6/8/10 s.
killer:scourge-hook-jagged-compass.tip: Use the generator reveal to defend the most dangerous generator.

killer:scourge-hook-monstrous-shrine.summary: Basement hooks and some other hooks become Scourge Hooks; staying away from them speeds up regression.
facts: At the start, the 4 Basement hooks and 4 other hooks become Scourge Hooks.
You see Scourge Hooks in white.
While you stay over 24 m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, generator regression runs at 150/175/200% of normal.
killer:scourge-hook-monstrous-shrine.tip: Leave the hook after hooking to get the regression bonus.

killer:scourge-hook-pain-resonance.summary: The first Scourge hook on each Survivor makes the most advanced generator explode and lose progress.
facts: 4 hooks become Scourge Hooks when the match starts; you see them in white.
Starts with 4 Tokens.
The first time a Survivor is hooked on a Scourge Hook, 1 Token is spent:
the most advanced generator explodes, dropping 10/15/20% of its progress at once;
it then starts regressing;
Survivors working on it scream, without a Loud Noise Notification.
Disabled for the rest of the match once all tokens are used.
killer:scourge-hook-pain-resonance.tip: Hook each Survivor on a Scourge Hook once to use all four tokens.

killer:scourge-hook-weeping-wounds.summary: Survivors unhooked from Scourge Hooks bleed and, once healed, work slower until hurt again.
facts: 4 hooks become Scourge Hooks when the match starts; you see them in white.

After their first full heal, they heal and repair 10/13/16% slower until they are injured again.
killer:scourge-hook-weeping-wounds.tip: Pair with healing slowdown so Survivors avoid healing.

killer:secret-project.summary: Totem cleanses and blessings block a generator, and any blocked generator makes you Undetectable.
facts: Each cleanse or blessing of a totem blocks one random generator (not already blocked) for 20/25/30 s.
Whenever generators become blocked, you are Undetectable for 30 s.
killer:secret-project.tip: Pair with other blocking perks like Grim Embrace for long Undetectable windows.

killer:see-how-they-run.summary: Letting the Obsession escape chases gives you speed tokens, which attacks use up.
facts: +1 Token when you lose the Obsession in a chase; max 3 Tokens.
Any attack that could hurt a Survivor removes 1 Token.
With at least 1 Token you get 3/4/5% Haste per token, up to 9/12/15%.
Cool-down: 10 s between gaining tokens.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:see-how-they-run.tip: Let the Obsession go a few times early, then use the speed on others.

killer:septic-touch.summary: Survivors healing inside your Terror Radius become Blind and Exhausted.
facts: Survivors healing inside your Terror Radius are Blind and Exhausted.
Both effects stay for 20/25/30 s after the heal stops.
killer:septic-touch.tip: Interrupt heals to block their exhaustion perks for a long time.

killer:shadowborn.summary: Being blinded gives you a short speed boost instead of slowing you down.
facts: When you are blinded in any way, you get 6/8/10% Haste for 10 s.
killer:shadowborn.tip: Punish flashlight Survivors by catching them after the blind.

killer:shattered-hope.summary: You destroy Boon Totems instead of snuffing them, and totem actions block all totems briefly.
facts: You destroy Boon Totems instead of snuffing them.
Each totem cleanse, blessing or destruction blocks every totem for 16/18/20 s.
You also see all blessed totems for 16/18/20 s.

killer:silent-shadow.summary: Each hook makes you Undetectable briefly, and powered gates make it permanent.
facts: After hooking a Survivor you are Undetectable for 11/12/13 s.
When the Exit Gates get power, you stay Undetectable until the match ends.
killer:silent-shadow.tip: Use the hook window to surprise Survivors coming for the rescue.

killer:sloppy-butcher.summary: Your hits make Survivors bleed heavily and heal slower for over a minute.
facts: Survivors hit by your basic attack are Haemorrhaged and Mangled for 70/80/90 s.
Their blood pools appear 50/75/100% more often.
Partial heal progress drops +25% faster.
killer:sloppy-butcher.tip: Pair with A Nurse's Calling to find Survivors who try to heal.

killer:spies-from-the-shadows.summary: Crows startled by Survivors near you alert you with a special sound.
facts: Crows startled by a Survivor up to 36/38/40 m away give you a crow-shaped Loud Noise Notification.
Cool-down: 3 s between alerts.
killer:spies-from-the-shadows.tip: Great for finding stealthy Survivors moving between generators.

killer:spirit-fury.summary: After breaking a few pallets, the next pallet that stuns you breaks instantly.
facts: Activates after you break 4/3/2 dropped pallets yourself.
The next pallet a Survivor stuns you with breaks at once.
The stun still lasts as long as usual.
Turns off after use.
killer:spirit-fury.tip: Pair with Enduring to recover quickly from the stun.

killer:starstruck.summary: While you carry a Survivor, everyone in your Terror Radius becomes Exposed.
facts: While you carry someone, every other Survivor inside your Terror Radius is Exposed.
Exposed stays 26/28/30 s after they leave your Terror Radius or the perk ends.
Ends when you hook or drop the Survivor.
Cool-down: 60 s.
killer:starstruck.tip: Walk toward Survivors who come for a body block or flashlight save.

killer:stridor.summary: Survivors' pain grunts and breathing are louder, making them easier to find by sound.

killer:superior-anatomy.summary: A Survivor fast-vaulting near you makes your next vaults much faster for a short time.
facts: When a Survivor fast-vaults within 12 m, it is active for 10 s.
Your vaults are 30/35/40% faster.
Cool-down: 20 s.
killer:superior-anatomy.tip: Follow the Survivor over the window right away.

killer:surge.summary: Downing a Survivor with a basic attack makes nearby generators explode and regress.
facts: When your basic attack downs a Survivor, generators within 32 m explode.
They lose 6/7/8% progress at once and start regressing.
killer:surge.tip: Chase Survivors near generators to trigger it more often.

killer:surveillance.summary: Shows the state of generators you kicked, and makes Survivors repairing louder.
facts: Damaged generators show in white while regressing.
They show in yellow when a Survivor stopped the regression.
The yellow lasts 8/12/16 s, then the normal colour returns.
Repair noises can be heard +8 m further.
killer:surveillance.tip: Kick generators, then return to the yellow ones.

killer:terminus.summary: In the endgame, injured, downed or hooked Survivors become Broken and cannot be healed.
facts: Activates when the Exit Gates get power.
Injured, downed and hooked Survivors become Broken.
It lasts until a gate is opened, then for another 35/40/45 s.
killer:terminus.tip: Pair with No Way Out or Blood Warden for strong endgame pressure.

killer:territorial-imperative.summary: Survivors entering the Basement while you are far away are revealed to you.

Cool-down: 45 s.
killer:territorial-imperative.tip: Hook Survivors in the Basement to catch rescuers coming down.

killer:thanatophobia.summary: Every hurt, downed or hooked Survivor slows the whole team's work a little.

All Survivors cleanse, repair and sabotage 1/1.5/2% slower per such Survivor, up to 4/6/8%.
If all four are injured, downed or hooked, the penalty grows by +12% to 16/18/20%.
killer:thanatophobia.tip: Spread injuries rather than downing one Survivor.

killer:thrilling-tremors.summary: Picking up a Survivor blocks all generators nobody is working on for a short time.
facts: When you pick up a Survivor, generators no one is repairing are blocked for 16 s.
You see the blocked generators in white.
Cool-down: 40/35/30 s.
killer:thrilling-tremors.tip: Check which generators are not blocked; Survivors are working there.

killer:thwack.summary: Breaking walls and pallets makes nearby Survivors scream and reveal themselves, using tokens.
facts: Starts with 3 Tokens.
Breaking a wall or dropped pallet uses 1 Token.
Survivors within 36 m then scream; you see them for 4/5/6 s.
+1 Token each time you hook a Survivor.
killer:thwack.tip: Break pallets near generators to find Survivors working there.

killer:tinkerer.summary: Generators reaching 70% alert you, and you become Undetectable for a while.
facts: When a generator reaches 70%, you get a Loud Noise Notification there.
You are Undetectable for 12/14/16 s.
Once per generator per match.
killer:tinkerer.tip: Go straight to the alerted generator to surprise the Survivors.

killer:trail-of-torment.summary: Kicking a generator makes you Undetectable until its regression stops, but Survivors see it.
facts: Damaging a generator makes you Undetectable.
All Survivors see that generator highlighted in yellow.
Ends when that generator stops regressing.
Cool-down: 60/45/30 s.
killer:trail-of-torment.tip: Kick a generator, then sneak to another area while Undetectable.

killer:turn-back-the-clock.summary: After a hook you can make a nearby generator explode and regress by pressing a button.
facts: For 40/50/60 s after a hook, press Active Ability to target a generator within 20 m.
It explodes, loses 10% progress and starts regressing.
killer:turn-back-the-clock.tip: Hook near generators to use it right away.

killer:ultimate-weapon.summary: Opening a locker makes Survivors near it scream, reveal their location and lose aura reading.
facts: Searching a locker affects all Survivors within 40 m of it.
They scream and show their location.
They are Blind for 30 s.
Cool-down: 55/50/45 s.
killer:ultimate-weapon.tip: Open a locker on your way across the map to find Survivors.

killer:unbound.summary: After a Survivor gets injured, vaulting windows gives you a small speed boost.
facts: When a Survivor becomes injured, it is active for 26/28/30 s.
Vaulting a window then gives +5% Haste for 25 s.
Does not stack with itself.
killer:unbound.tip: Strong on Killers who chase through window loops.

killer:undone.summary: Hooks give tokens that you spend on a kick to regress and block a generator.
facts: +1 Token per hook; max 1/2/3 Tokens.
Damaging a generator uses all tokens.
The generator loses 10% per token, up to 10/20/30%.
It is blocked for 10 s per token, up to 10/20/30 s.
After the block it starts regressing.
killer:undone.tip: Save tokens for a generator that is almost done.

killer:unforeseen.summary: Kicking a generator moves your Terror Radius there while you become Undetectable.
facts: After damaging a generator, for 22/26/30 s:
your Terror Radius moves to that generator and is set to 32 m;
you are Undetectable.
Cool-down: 30 s.
killer:unforeseen.tip: Survivors will run away from the generator, often straight toward you.

killer:unnerving-presence.summary: Survivors working in your Terror Radius get more skill checks that are harder to hit.
facts: In your Terror Radius, repairing and healing Survivors get +10% more skill checks.
The Good zone of those checks is 40/50/60% smaller.
killer:unnerving-presence.tip: Pair with Overcharge or Huntress Lullaby.

killer:unrelenting.summary: You recover faster after missed and successful basic attacks.
facts: Recovery after a missed basic attack is 30/35/40% faster.
Recovery after a hit is 10% faster.
killer:unrelenting.tip: Good for Killers who often miss swings around loops.

killer:wandering-eye.summary: Starting a chase shows other injured Survivors close to you.
facts: When a chase starts, you see other injured Survivors within 20 m for 5 s.
Cool-down: 40/35/30 s.
killer:wandering-eye.tip: Switch to an injured Survivor if they are closer.

killer:weave-attunement.summary: Items that run out are dropped and revealed to you, along with Survivors near them.
facts: Items running out for the first time are dropped automatically.
You see dropped Survivor items and Survivors within 12 m of them.
Those Survivors see the item too.
Survivors picking up an item are Oblivious for 20/25/30 s.
killer:weave-attunement.tip: Check the dropped items; Survivors often come back for them.

killer:whispers.summary: You hear whispers when a Survivor is near you, and move faster when none are.
facts: The Entity whispers to you whenever a Survivor is no more than 28/26/24 m away.
With nobody inside that 28/26/24 m range, you get +5% Haste.
killer:whispers.tip: Use the whispers to find Survivors hiding around you.

killer:zanshin-tactics.summary: Shows nearby pallets and windows, and reveals Survivors who drop a pallet.
facts: You see pallets and windows within 32 m.
When a Survivor drops a pallet, you see them for 3/4/5 s.
killer:zanshin-tactics.tip: Use it to learn loops and avoid wasting time at strong pallets.

survivor:a-place-for-us.summary: Healing teammates makes both of you hard to track, with an extra stealth window after you mend the Obsession.
facts: While you heal any other Survivor, you and they are Elusive.
Finishing a heal on the Obsession: you and the Obsession stay Elusive for 20/25/30 s.
Your chance to start as the Obsession drops by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:a-place-for-us.tip: Prioritise healing the Obsession to bank the longer Elusive window for both of you.

survivor:ace-in-the-hole.summary: Items you pull from chests arrive with add-ons, and the add-ons on your item survive when you escape.
facts: Regular items taken from a chest get 1 to 2 add-ons.
First add-on slot: 100% chance, Visceral rarity or below.
Second add-on slot: 50/75/100% chance, Uncommon rarity or below.
Add-ons on the item you hold are not used up when you escape.
survivor:ace-in-the-hole.tip: Pair with chest perks like Plunderer's Instinct to farm loaded items each match.

survivor:adrenaline.summary: When the gates get power, you instantly heal one state and get a short sprint, even while Exhausted.
facts: Fires on its own the moment the Exit Gates get power.
Heals you one Health State.
+50% Haste for 4 s.
Works while you are Exhausted and is not blocked by a status effect you already have.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 s.
survivor:adrenaline.tip: Stay injured near the end so the free heal and sprint matter when the last generator pops.

survivor:aftercare.summary: Keeps track of teammates you helped or who helped you, showing your auras to each other.
facts: Shows the auras of your 1/2/3 latest linked Survivors.
A link forms by a hook rescue or a finished heal, in either direction.
Those Survivors see your aura too.
Getting hooked clears the list.
survivor:aftercare.tip: Great for coordinating heals in solo queue without voice chat.

survivor:alert.summary: Shows you where the Killer is every time they kick a generator or break something.
facts: Triggers when the Killer does a Break or Damage action.
You see the Killer's aura for 3/4/5 s.
survivor:alert.tip: Use the reveal to judge whether a gen kick means the Killer is leaving or patrolling.

survivor:any-means-necessary.summary: Lets you see dropped pallets and lift them back up to restore a loop.
facts: You see the auras of pallets that have been dropped.
Hold the Active Ability button beside a dropped pallet to stand it up again.
Resetting takes 5/4/3 s.
survivor:any-means-necessary.tip: Reset pallets at strong loops while the Killer chases someone else.

survivor:apocalyptic-ingenuity.summary: After opening a chest you can rebuild broken pallets as one-use fragile pallets.
facts: You see broken pallet locations within 24/28/32 m.
Unlocks after you open or rummage 1 chest.
Hold Active Ability for 3 s at a broken pallet spot to rebuild it.
Rebuilt pallets are Fragile and break the moment they are dropped.
survivor:apocalyptic-ingenuity.tip: Rebuild pallets at your strongest loops; a fragile pallet still blocks one stun window.

survivor:appraisal.summary: Rummage through opened chests faster and pull a second item out of them.
facts: Starts with 4 Tokens.
Hold Interaction at an opened, empty chest to rummage it.
A rummage gives one extra item and uses 1 Token; at most twice per chest.
Rummaging is 40/60/80% faster.
survivor:appraisal.tip: Combine with Ace in the Hole for extra items that already carry add-ons.

survivor:autodidact.summary: Each successful skill check while healing teammates builds tokens that make later Good skill checks heal more.
facts: +1 Token for each passed skill check when you heal a teammate; max 3/4/5 Tokens.
Great healing skill checks no longer appear.
Good healing skill checks add progress by tokens: 0 → -15%, 1 → +0%, 2 → +15%, 3 → +30%, 4 → +45%, 5 → +60%.
Tier I caps at 3 Tokens, Tier II at 4, Tier III at 5.
Does nothing when you heal with a Med-Kit.
survivor:autodidact.tip: Heal teammates early in the match so tokens are stacked when heals matter most.

survivor:babysitter.summary: After you unhook someone you see the Killer, while the rescued Survivor leaves no trail and runs faster.
facts: On unhooking another Survivor you see the Killer's aura for 8 s.
The rescued Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks or blood pools for 20/25/30 s.
Their Haste is boosted by +10% for that time.
survivor:babysitter.tip: Use the Killer reveal to call out whether they are camping or leaving.

survivor:background-player.summary: When the Killer picks up a teammate, you get a short window to sprint toward them for a save.
facts: Becomes active for 10 s when the Killer picks up another downed Survivor.
Starting to run while active: +50% Haste for 5 s.
Cannot trigger while Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 30/25/20 s.
survivor:background-player.tip: Stay close to chases so the sprint gets you to a pallet or flashlight save.

survivor:bada-bada-boom.summary: After some gen progress you can trap a window so the Killer is slowed when vaulting it.
facts: Activates after 20% of generator repair progress.
Press Active Ability at a window to set a trap lasting up to 40/50/60 s.
If the Killer vaults that window they are Hindered by -50% for 6 s.
Ends once it triggers or the timer runs out.
Trapped windows show to all Survivors in yellow.
survivor:bada-bada-boom.tip: Trap the window you plan to loop next so the Killer pays for following.

survivor:balanced-landing.summary: Dropping from heights is silent and gives you a quick burst of speed.
facts: When you fall, falling and landing sounds are muted.
Landing stagger is 75% shorter.
+50% Haste for 3 s after the fall.
Cannot trigger while Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 s.
survivor:balanced-landing.tip: Route chases over ledges and stairs so every drop turns into a free sprint.

survivor:bardic-inspiration.summary: Perform on the spot and roll a die to give nearby teammates faster skill-check progress.
facts: Press Active Ability while standing still to perform for up to 15 s.
Affects other Survivors within 16 m.
Result of a d20 roll, lasting 90 s after the performance:
1: you scream, but the Killer gets no notification.
2 - 10: +1% progress on skill checks.
11 - 19: +2% progress on skill checks.
20: +3% progress on skill checks.
Cool-down 110/100/90 s after finishing or cancelling.
survivor:bardic-inspiration.tip: Perform in a safe corner while teammates sit on generators.

survivor:best-gift-ever.summary: Sacrifice items to the Entity to unlock a lasting bonus tied to each item type.
facts: Starts with 4/5/6 Tokens.
First drop of each item type: spend 1 Token, the item is consumed and you get its bonus.
Flashlight: stunned Killers are blinded for 2 s.
Fog Vial: after a fast vault your Scratch Marks fade +50% faster for 5 s.
Key: one rummage allowed per chest.
Map: auras you see last +1 s longer.
Med-Kit: healing a Survivor also heals you at 25% speed.
Toolbox: you see the auras of the 3 nearest generators.
survivor:best-gift-ever.tip: Open chests early and feed spare items to stack several bonuses.

survivor:better-than-new.summary: Teammates you heal work faster on several actions until they are hit again.
facts: After you finish healing another Survivor they get faster Blessing, Cleansing, Healing and Unlocking.
Bonus is 40/45/50%.
Lasts until they take damage.
survivor:better-than-new.tip: Heal the teammate who will cleanse totems or open gates next.

survivor:better-together.summary: Shares the generator you work on with the team, and reveals everyone when a teammate goes down.
facts: While you repair, all Survivors see that generator's aura in yellow.
If a teammate is downed during your repair, you see all Survivors' auras for 20/25/30 s.
survivor:better-together.tip: Use the down reveal to see who is heading for the save.

survivor:bite-the-bullet.summary: Makes healing silent and softens the cost of missed healing skill checks.
facts: Healing yourself or others makes no healing noise and no Grunts of Pain.
Missed healing skill checks give no Loud Noise Notification.
Missed check penalty drops to 3/2/1% of total progress.
survivor:bite-the-bullet.tip: Strong with self-heal perks against Killers who listen for grunts.

survivor:blast-mine.summary: After repairing a while, trap a generator so the Killer gets stunned and blinded when kicking it.
facts: Activates after repairs worth 40% of a generator.
Press Active Ability at a generator to trap it; trap lasts 100/110/120 s.
Goes off midway through the Killer's damage action on that generator.
Stuns the Killer for 4 s and blinds every player within 12.5 m.
The trap ends when it fires or time runs out.
Trapped generators show to all Survivors in yellow.
survivor:blast-mine.tip: Trap the generator the Killer patrols most; stay away so you are not blinded too.

survivor:blood-pact.summary: Links you and the Obsession once either is injured: shared auras and speed after healing each other.
facts: Activates when you or the Obsession get injured.
You and the Obsession always see each other's aura.
Healing each other gives you both 5/6/7% Haste.
Haste holds while you stay within 16 m of each other.
If you are the Obsession and get hooked, another Survivor becomes the Obsession.
Your chance to start as the Obsession drops by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:blood-pact.tip: Stick near the Obsession during heals to keep the Haste running.

survivor:blood-rush.summary: After an unhook you can instantly clear Exhaustion once, so your exhaustion perk is ready again.
facts: Active for 40/50/60 s after you are unhooked in any way.
Press Active Ability to remove Exhaustion immediately.
Does not make you Exhausted itself.
Ends early on a Conspicuous Action.
Ends after use; disabled for the rest of the match after the Exit Gates get power.
survivor:blood-rush.tip: Pair with Sprint Burst or Lithe to use your exhaustion perk twice after an unhook.

survivor:boil-over.summary: Makes you harder to carry by pushing the Killer around more and hiding nearby hooks from them.
facts: While carried, your wiggling pushes the Killer 60/70/80% harder.
The Killer cannot see hook auras within 16 m of you.
If the Killer drops from a height, you gain +33% of your current wiggle progress.
survivor:boil-over.tip: Wiggle toward drops and hook-less areas to buy time for a save.

survivor:bond.summary: Always shows nearby teammates so you know where help or danger is.
facts: You see the auras of other Survivors within 20/28/36 m.
survivor:bond.tip: Use it to find teammates to share generators or get healed.

survivor:boon-circle-of-healing.summary: Bless a totem to speed up healing others nearby and show injured teammates to everyone.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem: it becomes a Boon Totem.
Effect range is 24 m; Survivors in range hear chimes.
Healing others is 50/75/100% faster without a Med-Kit.
Injured Survivors' auras are shown to the other Survivors.
Only one Circle of Healing affects a Survivor at a time.
Your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-circle-of-healing.tip: Bless a totem near the centre of the map so the team heals there.

survivor:boon-dark-theory.summary: Bless a totem to give a small permanent speed boost around it that lingers when you leave.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem: it becomes a Boon Totem.
Effect range is 24 m; Survivors in range hear chimes.
+3% Haste inside the range.
Haste stays for 2/3/4 s after leaving.
Your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-dark-theory.tip: Bless a totem near a strong loop so the extra speed helps in chases.

survivor:boon-exponential.summary: Bless a totem so downed Survivors nearby can pick themselves up, and recover faster.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem: it becomes a Boon Totem.
Effect range is 24 m; Survivors in range hear chimes.
Recovery in the Dying State is 90/95/100% faster.
Allows full self-recovery from the Dying State.
Your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-exponential.tip: Crawl to the boon after a down instead of waiting for a teammate.

survivor:boon-illumination.summary: Bless a totem to show chests and generators to Survivors nearby, and bless faster.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem: it becomes a Boon Totem.
Effect range is 24 m; Survivors in range hear chimes.
Survivors in range see all chest and generator auras in blue.
With your Boon Totem lit, you bless 150/175/200% faster.
Only one Illumination affects a Survivor at a time.
Your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-illumination.tip: Bless quickly after a snuff to keep other boons running.

survivor:boon-shadow-step.summary: Bless a totem to hide Survivors' tracks and auras from the Killer nearby.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem: it becomes a Boon Totem.
Effect range is 24 m; Survivors in range hear chimes.
No Scratch Marks in range.
The Killer cannot see Survivors' auras in range.
Both effects stay for 2/3/4 s after leaving.
Your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-shadow-step.tip: Lead chases through the boon to break line of sight and lose the Killer.

survivor:boon-steadfast.summary: Bless a totem to make nearby generators regress slower and repair faster.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem: it becomes a Boon Totem.
Effect range is 24 m; Survivors in range hear chimes.
Generators in range regress 50% slower.
Survivors repair those generators +8/9/10% faster.
Survivors in range see those generators' auras.
Only one Steadfast affects a Survivor at a time.
Your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-steadfast.tip: Bless a totem between two or three generators to cover them all.

survivor:borrowed-time.summary: Protects the teammate you unhook with a longer Endurance and Haste window.
facts: When you unhook another Survivor, their Endurance lasts 6/8/10 s longer, for 16/18/20 s total.
Any Conspicuous Action ends that Endurance early.
Their Haste lasts +10 s longer, for 20 s total.
survivor:borrowed-time.tip: Unhook when the Killer is close; the protected Survivor should run, not repair.

survivor:botany-knowledge.summary: A simple, always-on boost to how fast you heal.
facts: Permanent: your healing is 30/40/50% faster.
survivor:botany-knowledge.tip: Stacks well with Med-Kits and healing boons for quick team recovery.

survivor:bound-by-obsession.summary: Turns the Killer's aura reading against them, showing them to you and speeding your work while they look.
facts: Triggers each time your aura is read by the Killer, for as long as that reading lasts.
During it you see the Killer's aura.
During it Cleansing, Healing and Repairing are 8/9/10% faster.
If you are the current Obsession, every 30 s your aura shows to the Killer for 4 s.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:bound-by-obsession.tip: Strong against aura-heavy Killers; expect to be found more often as the Obsession.

survivor:breakdown.summary: The hook you are taken off breaks immediately, and you briefly see where the Killer is.
facts: Triggers when you are unhooked in any way.
That hook breaks at once.
It takes 180 s to repair itself.
You see the Killer's aura for 4/5/6 s.
survivor:breakdown.tip: Lead the Killer back toward the broken hook area to force long carries.

survivor:breakout.summary: Staying close to the Killer while they carry a teammate speeds you up and helps your friend wiggle free.
facts: Works while you are within 5 m of a Killer who is carrying a teammate.
You get 6/8/10% Haste.
The carried Survivor wiggles +25% faster.
Only one Breakout affects a Survivor at a time.
survivor:breakout.tip: Body-block in front of the Killer during carries to steer them away from hooks.

survivor:buckle-up.summary: Picking up a downed teammate shows you both the Killer, then sends them away fast and trackless.
facts: Triggers when you heal a Survivor in the Dying State.
During the heal, you and the downed Survivor see the Killer's aura.
After the heal, for 3/4/5 s, the healed Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks.
In that window they also get +50% Haste.
Does not make anyone Exhausted.
survivor:buckle-up.tip: Watch the Killer's aura to pick the right moment to finish the pick-up.

survivor:built-to-last.summary: Hide in a locker with an empty item to refill it, up to three times per match.
facts: Hide in a locker holding a depleted item for 12/10/8 s.
Charges are restored to 99% the first time.
Second time: 66%.
Third time: 33%.
Turns off for the rest of the match after the third use.
survivor:built-to-last.tip: Best with strong items like Med-Kits or Toolboxes you want to use again.

survivor:calm-spirit.summary: Keeps you quiet: crows stay put, you never scream, and chests and totems make no sound.
facts: Nearby crows do not fly up unless you get within touching distance.
You never scream, whatever the cause.
No sound when you use chests or totems.
Blessing, Cleansing and Unlocking are 8/9/10% faster.
survivor:calm-spirit.tip: Counters Killers who rely on scream perks like Infectious Fright.

survivor:camaraderie.summary: If a teammate comes close while you struggle on a hook, the struggle timer pauses for a while.
facts: Works when you reach the Struggle Phase on a hook.
A Survivor within 16 m of your hook pauses the struggle timer for 26/30/34 s.
survivor:camaraderie.tip: Teammates should approach early so the pause buys time for a safe rescue.

survivor:champion-of-light.summary: Run faster while using a flashlight and slow the Killer after you blind them.
facts: While your flashlight is on: +50% Haste.
Blinding the Killer in any way Hinders them by -20% for 6 s.
The Hindered effect does not stack.
Cool-down: 60/50/40 s after a blind.
survivor:champion-of-light.tip: Blind the Killer when they are close in a chase to escape to the next loop.

survivor:change-of-plan.summary: Inside a locker you can swap your Toolbox for an equally rare Med-Kit.
facts: Starts with 2 Tokens.
Inside a locker, with a regular (non-event) Toolbox in hand, press Active Ability; this spends 1 Token.
The Toolbox turns into a Med-Kit of matching rarity, plus one random add-on of matching rarity.
Charges on the new Med-Kit: 80/90/100%.
survivor:change-of-plan.tip: Bring a Toolbox for gens early and switch to a Med-Kit once you get hit.

survivor:chemical-trap.summary: After some repair work you can trap a dropped pallet so the Killer is slowed when breaking it.
facts: Activates after 20% of total generator repairs.
Press Active Ability at a dropped pallet to set a trap for 40/50/60 s.
If the Killer breaks that pallet the trap goes off.
The Killer is Hindered by -50% for 4 s.
Ends once it fires or the timer runs out.
Trapped pallets show to all Survivors in yellow.
survivor:chemical-trap.tip: Trap a pallet you just dropped in chase so the break costs the Killer extra time.

survivor:clairvoyance.summary: Once you have cleansed or blessed a totem, you can stand still to see key objects across a large area.
facts: Activates once you cleanse or bless any totem.
Hold Use Item with empty hands to use it.
You see chests, Exit Gate switches, generators, the Hatch and hooks within 64 m.
Lasts while you hold it, up to 10/11/12 s.
survivor:clairvoyance.tip: Use it late in the match to find the Hatch or the nearest gate.

survivor:clean-break.summary: After healing a teammate, you can accept Broken to get healed by yourself automatically later.
facts: Activates after you finish healing another Survivor.
Press Active Ability while a teammate heals you.
You become Broken.
You heal 1 Health State on your own after 75/60/45 s.
Going into the Dying State cancels it.
Will not activate if you are already Broken.
Turns off after it heals you.
survivor:clean-break.tip: Use it when there is no time for a full heal and you want to repair.

survivor:come-and-get-me.summary: After a rescue you can scream to pull the Killer to you while hiding injured teammates' traces.
facts: Works after you unhook a Survivor, while you crouch without moving.
Press Active Ability to use it.
For 10/12.5/15 s, injured or downed Survivors within 24 m leave no grunts, blood or Scratch Marks.
You scream and your aura shows to the Killer for 5 s.
survivor:come-and-get-me.tip: Use it right after the unhook so the rescued Survivor gets away clean.

survivor:conviction.summary: After healing someone, you can pick yourself up from the Dying State for a limited time.
facts: Requires you to have finished healing another Survivor at some point.
In the Dying State, press Active Ability once your recovery reaches 25%.
You can then fully recover by yourself.
You become Broken.
After 20/25/30 s you drop back into the Dying State.
survivor:conviction.tip: Use the time on your feet to reach a teammate who can heal you.

survivor:corrective-action.summary: Save teammates from missed skill checks by turning their failures into Good checks.
facts: Starts with 1/2/3 Tokens; each Great skill check you hit adds +1, up to 5 Tokens.
When another Survivor misses a skill check, it becomes a Good one instead.
Each save uses 1 Token.
You then see that Survivor's aura for 6 s.
Special skill checks are not covered.
