survivor:corrective-action.tip: Repair with teammates who struggle with skill checks to avoid gen explosions.

survivor:counterforce.summary: Cleanse totems much faster, getting quicker each time, and see where the next far totem is.
facts: Permanent: your base cleansing speed is 125%.
Each totem you cleanse adds +25% cleansing speed, stacking.
After a cleanse you see the aura of the farthest totem for 10/12/14 s.
survivor:counterforce.tip: Great against Hex builds; chain cleanses early in the match.

survivor:cross-examination.summary: Inside the Terror Radius you see light trails the Killer leaves, which make you harder to track.
facts: Works inside the Terror Radius while you are not being chased.
You can see the Light Marks left by the moving Killer; each lasts 10 s.
Standing on a Light Mark makes you Elusive.
Elusive stays for 3/4/5 s after leaving it.
survivor:cross-examination.tip: Walk along the Killer's recent path to stay hidden from aura perks.

survivor:cut-loose.summary: Fast vaults during a chase become silent for a short time, and chaining vaults keeps it going.
facts: A fast vault in a chase activates it for 4/5/6 s.
Fast vaults make no sound, including the Killer's Loud Noise Notification.
Each new fast vault while active resets the timer.
Cool-down: 45 s once it ends.
survivor:cut-loose.tip: Chain vaults at windows close to each other to lose the Killer.

survivor:dance-with-me.summary: Fast vaults through windows or fast locker exits hide your Scratch Marks for a moment.
facts: Triggers on a fast window vault or a fast locker exit.
No Scratch Marks for 5 s.
Cool-down: 20/20/15 s.
survivor:dance-with-me.tip: Vault and turn a corner right away to break line of sight.

survivor:dark-sense.summary: After a generator is done, the Killer's approach reveals them, other Survivors and nearby pallets and windows.
facts: Arms whenever a generator is completed.
When the Killer comes within 24 m of you, it triggers for 13/14/15 s.
You see the Killer's aura and the other Survivors' auras.
You see pallets and windows within 32 m.
Turns off after use, until the next generator.
survivor:dark-sense.tip: Plan your escape route with the pallet and window auras it shows.

survivor:dead-hard.summary: After an unhook, a well-timed dash gives you a split second of Endurance to absorb a hit.
facts: Unlocks after you are unhooked in any way.
Press Active Ability while injured and running.
You get Endurance for 0.5 s.
Cannot be used while Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 s.
survivor:dead-hard.tip: Time it right before the hit lands; using it too early wastes it.

survivor:deadline.summary: When injured you get more skill checks in random spots, but missing them hurts less.
facts: Active while you are injured.
Skill checks trigger 6/8/10% more often while repairing or healing.
Skill checks appear anywhere on screen.
Missed skill check penalty is reduced by 50%.
survivor:deadline.tip: Good with skill-check perks like Hyperfocus or Stake Out.

survivor:deception.summary: Fake a locker entry to send the Killer to the wrong place while you run off trackless.
facts: Hold Sprint while interacting with a locker.
You run past instead of getting in.
The locker doors open and shut as if you jumped in.
The Killer gets a Loud Noise Notification at the locker.
No Scratch Marks or blood for 5 s.
Cool-down: 25/20/15 s.
survivor:deception.tip: Use it near a corner or tall cover so the Killer cannot see you leave.

survivor:decisive-strike.summary: After an unhook, escape the Killer's grip once by hitting a skill check, stunning them.
facts: Active for 40/50/60 s after you are unhooked or unhook yourself.
When the Killer grabs or picks you up, hit a skill check to break free.
Stuns the Killer for 4 s.
You become the next Obsession.
Turns off when the Exit Gates get power.
Can be used once per match.
A Conspicuous Action ends it early.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:decisive-strike.tip: Avoid repairing or healing right after an unhook to keep it active.

survivor:deja-vu.summary: Shows the three generators closest together and lets you repair them a bit faster.
facts: You see the auras of the 3 generators that are nearest to each other.
Your repairs on those generators are 4/5/6% faster.
survivor:deja-vu.tip: Work on those generators early to avoid a tight three-gen late in the match.

survivor:deliverance.summary: After safely rescuing a teammate, you can free yourself from your first hook.
facts: Activates after you safely unhook another Survivor.
You can unhook yourself with certainty during your first hook stage.
After that you are Broken for 160/140/120 s.
Not usable in the second hook stage or as the last Survivor alive.
Can be used once per match.
survivor:deliverance.tip: Unhook a teammate early so you have the self-unhook ready for your first hook.

survivor:desperate-measures.summary: The more teammates are hurt, downed or hooked, the faster you heal and unhook.
facts: Active when any Survivor, you included, is not healthy.
Healing and Unhooking are 16/18/20% faster per injured, downed or hooked Survivor.
Maximum bonus 64/72/80%.
survivor:desperate-measures.tip: Great support perk against Killers who injure the whole team.

survivor:detectives-hunch.summary: Every finished generator briefly shows nearby chests, generators and totems.
facts: Triggers whenever a generator is completed.
You see chests, generators and totems within 32/48/64 m.
The reveal lasts 20 s.
survivor:detectives-hunch.tip: Use the totem reveal to find and cleanse Hex totems quickly.

survivor:distortion.summary: Blocks the Killer's aura reading on you for a while and recharges during chases.
facts: Starts with 1 Token; can hold 2 Tokens.
When the Killer tries to read your aura it spends 1 Token automatically.
For 8/10/12 s your aura cannot be read.
During that time you leave no Scratch Marks.
Gain +1 Token every 15 s of being chased.
Does not trigger while you are in the Dying State.
survivor:distortion.tip: Watch the token count: a used token often means the Killer has aura perks.

survivor:diversion.summary: After lurking unchased in the Terror Radius, throw a pebble to lure the Killer somewhere else.
facts: Charges after 30/25/20 s spent in the Terror Radius with no chase on you.
Crouch, stand still and press Active Ability to throw a pebble where you face.
It lands 20 m away and gives the Killer a Loud Noise Notification there.
It also leaves fake Scratch Marks.
Turns off after use.
survivor:diversion.tip: Throw it away from your hiding spot just before the Killer comes around the corner.

survivor:do-no-harm.summary: Heal teammates who have been hooked more often much faster, with better skill-check rewards.
facts: Healing another Survivor: +30/35/40% speed per hook stage they have, max 60/70/80%.
Great healing skill checks give +3% extra progress per hook stage, max +6%.
Skill checks are +5% more likely per hook stage, max +5%.
survivor:do-no-harm.tip: Prioritise healing teammates on their second hook stage to get the full bonus.

survivor:down-to-the-last.summary: Builds tokens from hooks and repairs that speed up teammates at the gates and help you alone.
facts: +1 Token each time you are hooked or repair a generator; max 6 Tokens.
Each token makes teammates +10% quicker at opening Exit Gates.
As the last Survivor alive with 3 or more Tokens, you can open the Hatch without a Key.
Then each token keeps the Killer from reading your aura for 6/8/10 s.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:down-to-the-last.tip: Keep repairing generators to stack tokens for the endgame.

survivor:dramaturgy.summary: A chaotic sprint ability for healthy Survivors, followed by a random extra effect that may help or hurt.
facts: Active while you are fully healthy.
Press Active Ability while running: 0.5 s of high-knee running, then +25 Haste for 2 s.
Then one random extra effect, never the same twice in a row:
a second Haste burst;
Exposed for 12 s;
you scream;
a random Rare item with random add-ons (you drop the item you held).
Cannot be used while Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 s.
survivor:dramaturgy.tip: Use it away from the Killer so a bad roll like Exposed costs you less.

survivor:duty-of-care.summary: Taking a hit for a teammate while healthy gives everyone near you a burst of speed.
facts: When healthy and you take a Protection Hit, other Survivors within 12 m get +25% Haste.
The Haste lasts 4/5/6 s.
survivor:duty-of-care.tip: Body-block for an injured teammate so they can sprint to safety.

survivor:empathic-connection.summary: You heal others faster, and injured teammates can see where you are to come to you.
facts: Permanent: healing others is 30/35/40% faster.
Injured Survivors see your aura as a possible healer.
survivor:empathic-connection.tip: Stay near generators in the middle of the map so injured teammates reach you quickly.

survivor:empathy.summary: Shows you injured and downed teammates from a long way off.
facts: Injured and downed teammates within 64/96/128 m show to you as auras.
survivor:empathy.tip: Use it to find teammates to heal or to see where the chase is.

survivor:extrasensory-perception.summary: Crouch to see the area around you in growing detail while hard to track and unable to hear the Killer.
facts: Crouch for 4 s to activate.
You see Survivors, the Killer and objects in a radius growing to 44 m.
Objects shown: generators, chests, pallets, windows, totems, items, the Hatch and the Exit Gate.
You are Elusive and Oblivious while it runs.
Ends when you stand up or after 11 s.
Cool-down: 60/50/40 s.
survivor:extrasensory-perception.tip: Use it right after spawning or a chase to plan your next move.

survivor:exultation.summary: Stunning the Killer with a pallet recharges and upgrades the item you hold.
facts: Requires holding an item.
A pallet stun on the Killer recharges your item by +75%.
The item rises to the next rarity.
Cool-down: 30/25/20 s.
survivor:exultation.tip: Bring a cheap item and loop pallets to upgrade it during the match.

survivor:eyes-of-belmont.summary: Each finished generator briefly shows the Killer, and every Killer reveal you get lasts longer.
facts: When a generator is completed, you see the Killer's aura for 1/2/3 s.
All reveals of the Killer's aura to you last +2 s longer.
This extra time also applies to its own reveal.
survivor:eyes-of-belmont.tip: Pair with other Killer-reveal perks like Alert or Fogwise for longer looks.

survivor:fast-track.summary: Unhooking teammates stores tokens that you cash in on a Great skill check to cut a generator's work.
facts: +1 Token per Survivor you unhook; max 1/2/3 Tokens.
A Great repair skill check uses up all tokens.
That generator then needs 5 fewer charges per token, permanently.
survivor:fast-track.tip: After a rescue, go to a generator and hit a Great skill check soon.

survivor:finesse.summary: While healthy your fast vaults are quicker, with a cool-down after each one.
facts: Active while you are healthy.
Fast vaults are +20% faster.
Cool-down: 40/35/30 s after a fast vault.
survivor:finesse.tip: Lead the Killer to window loops early in a chase while still healthy.

survivor:five-moves-ahead.summary: In chases or near the Killer you see the nearest pallets and recover faster after dropping one.
facts: Active while being chased or inside the Terror Radius.
After dropping a pallet you can move 50% sooner.
The 5 nearest pallets show to you as auras.
Cool-down: 40/35/30 s after dropping a pallet while active.
survivor:five-moves-ahead.tip: Use the pallet auras to plan routes on maps you do not know well.

survivor:fixated.summary: Walk faster and see your own Scratch Marks to judge how visible your trail is.
facts: Permanent: walking is 10/15/20% faster.
You can see your own Scratch Marks.
survivor:fixated.tip: Walk instead of run when the Killer is close to leave no trail.

survivor:flashbang.summary: After some repair work, make a flash grenade inside a locker to blind the Killer.
facts: Activates after generator repairs worth 50/45/40% in total.
Press Active Ability while inside a locker to make a Flash Grenade.
Turns off after use.
survivor:flashbang.tip: Throw the grenade during a pick-up to save a teammate.

survivor:flip-flop.summary: Recovering while downed also fills your wiggle bar, giving you a head start if you are picked up.
facts: In the Dying State, recovering also fills your wiggle bar at 50% of your recovery speed.
Wiggle progress from this is capped at 40/45/50%.
survivor:flip-flop.tip: Combine with Unbreakable or Tenacity to keep recovering while downed.

survivor:flow-state.summary: Each finished generator makes you faster at totems, healing and unhooking.
facts: +1 token per completed generator; max 5.
Per token: blessing and cleansing totems 13/14/15% faster.
Per token: healing 13/14/15% faster.
Per token: unhooking 13/14/15% faster.
survivor:flow-state.tip: It peaks late, so play support roles in the second half of the match.

survivor:fogwise.summary: Hitting Great skill checks on generators shows you where the Killer is.
facts: While repairing, a Great skill check shows you the Killer's aura for 4/5/6 s.
survivor:fogwise.tip: Hit Great checks reliably to track the Killer while you repair.

survivor:for-the-people.summary: Instantly heal a teammate one state by taking the hit yourself and becoming the Obsession.
facts: Works when you are healthy and heal a teammate without a Med-Kit.
Press Active Ability to hand over 1 of your health states.
A dying or Deep Wound Survivor goes straight to Injured.
An injured Survivor goes straight to full health.
You become injured and Broken for 80/70/60 s.
You become the Obsession if you were not already.
Your chance to start as the Obsession drops by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:for-the-people.tip: Use it to pick up a downed teammate fast when the Killer is close.

survivor:friendly-competition.summary: Finishing a generator together with a teammate speeds up everyone's later repairs.
facts: Triggers when you and at least one teammate complete a generator together.
Everyone who helped repairs +10% faster for 80/85/90 s.
survivor:friendly-competition.tip: Move to the next generator together to use the bonus straight away.

survivor:fruits-of-your-labor.summary: Every finished generator adds a token; finishing your own then gives speed and healing.
facts: +1 token whenever any generator is completed.
When you finish a generator, per token: +5% Haste for 2 s.
Per token also 10/15/20% healing progress.
survivor:fruits-of-your-labor.tip: Finish generators yourself late in the match for a big free heal.

survivor:ghost-notes.summary: While Exhausted your trail fades faster and you recover from Exhaustion sooner.
facts: While Exhausted, your Scratch Marks fade +50% faster.
Exhaustion wears off 5/7.5/10% faster.
Does not make you Exhausted itself.
survivor:ghost-notes.tip: Pair with an exhaustion perk like Sprint Burst to disappear after the sprint.

survivor:hardened.summary: After opening a chest and touching a totem, any scream you would make reveals the Killer instead.
facts: Activates once you have opened a chest and blessed or cleansed a totem.
You never scream.
Instead, you see the Killer's aura for 3/4/5 s.
survivor:hardened.tip: Great against Killers with scream effects, like Doctor.

survivor:head-on.summary: Hide in a locker, then burst out to stun a Killer standing right in front of it.
facts: Activates after 3 s inside a locker.
Hold Sprint while leaving the locker to jump out.
A Killer within 2.5 m is stunned for 3 s.
A miss gives the Killer a Loud Noise Notification.
Cannot be used while Exhausted.
After a successful stun you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 s.
survivor:head-on.tip: Lure the Killer to a locker in chase and hide just before they round a corner.

survivor:hope.summary: Once the gates are powered, you move a bit faster for the rest of the match.
facts: After the Exit Gates are powered: 3/4/5% Haste until the end of the match.
survivor:hope.tip: Use the extra speed to make risky endgame saves.

survivor:hyperfocus.summary: Chaining Great skill checks builds tokens that give bigger rewards but faster, more frequent checks.
facts: +1 Token for each Great skill check during repairs or heals; max 6 Tokens.
Per token: +4% skill check chance and +4% needle speed, max +24% each.
Per token: Great check bonus progress grows by 10/20/30% of the base value, max 60/120/180%.
You lose all tokens on a Good check, a miss, or an interrupted action.
survivor:hyperfocus.tip: Pair with Stake Out for extra Great checks and safety on hard ones.

survivor:inner-focus.summary: See other Survivors' Scratch Marks, and see the Killer each time they hurt a teammate.
facts: Teammates' Scratch Marks are visible to you.
When the Killer takes a health state from another Survivor, you see the Killer's aura for 6/8/10 s.
survivor:inner-focus.tip: Use the Scratch Marks to find teammates for heals or to avoid the chase.

survivor:inner-strength.summary: After cleansing a totem, a short locker stay heals you one state.
facts: Activates after cleansing any totem.
Hide in any locker for 10/9/8 s to heal one health state.
Turns off after use.
Does not work while Broken.
survivor:inner-strength.tip: Cleanse totems early to keep a free self-heal for after your first hit.

survivor:invocation-treacherous-crows.summary: A basement ritual that makes crows betray the Killer, at the cost of being Broken all match.
facts: Press Active Ability at the circle in the Basement to start; it takes 60 s.
Other Survivors see your aura and can help: +100% speed with an Invocation perk, +50% without.
After it ends: when a crow is startled by the Killer and a Survivor is inside the Terror Radius, all Survivors see the Killer's aura for 1/1.5/2 s.
You become injured and stay Broken for the rest of the match.
survivor:invocation-treacherous-crows.tip: Do the ritual early when the Killer is busy far from the Basement.

survivor:invocation-weaving-spiders.summary: A basement ritual that makes every generator need fewer charges, at the cost of being Broken all match.
facts: Press Active Ability at the circle in the Basement to start; it takes 60 s.
Other Survivors see your aura and can help: +100% speed with an Invocation perk, +50% without.
After it ends, all generators need 8/9/10 fewer charges permanently.
You become injured and stay Broken for the rest of the match.
Once done, other copies of this Invocation stop working this match.
survivor:invocation-weaving-spiders.tip: Only one Survivor should bring it; do it early for the biggest gain.

survivor:iron-will.summary: Mutes your pained grunts while injured, so the Killer cannot hear you hiding.
facts: While injured, your Grunts of Pain are 80/90/100% quieter.
Does not work while Exhausted, but never makes you Exhausted.
survivor:iron-will.tip: Break line of sight in chase and stand still behind cover to lose the Killer.

survivor:kindred.summary: When anyone is hooked, the team sees each other and the Killer near the hook, making rescues safer.
facts: Triggers whenever a Survivor is hooked.
All Survivors see the Killer when the Killer is within 14/15/16 m of that hook.
If you are the one hooked, all Survivors see each other's auras.
If someone else is hooked, only you see the other Survivors.
survivor:kindred.tip: One of the best solo-queue perks: it stops two people going for the same save.

survivor:last-stand.summary: After lurking unchased near the Killer for a while, one fast vault can stun them.
facts: Charges after 120/105/90 s in the Terror Radius with no chase on you.
Then a fast vault stuns the Killer for 3 s if they are within 2.5 m of the window.
One use per match.
survivor:last-stand.tip: Save it for a tall window loop where the Killer follows you closely.

survivor:leader.summary: Teammates near you work faster on most actions, and the boost lingers after they leave.
facts: Affects other Survivors within 10 m of you.
Healing, unhooking, unlocking, cleansing, sabotage and gate opening are 20/25/30% faster.
The boost stays for 15 s after leaving the area.
Only one Leader affects a Survivor at a time.
survivor:leader.tip: Stick with teammates on heals and gates for the biggest effect.

survivor:left-behind.summary: If you are the last one standing, you see the Hatch when you get close to it.
facts: Active when you are the only Survivor left alive.
You see the Hatch's aura within 24/28/32 m.
survivor:left-behind.tip: Sweep the map in wide loops to bring the Hatch into range.

survivor:lend-a-hand.summary: After a totem cleanse or blessing, you can give a teammate you heal extra self-heal charges.
facts: Activates after you cleanse or bless a totem.
While healing a Survivor, press Active Ability 2 to hand them 2/3/4 healing charges that do not run out.
Once per Survivor.
survivor:lend-a-hand.tip: Give charges to the teammate most likely to be chased next.

survivor:light-footed.summary: Your running footsteps are silent while healthy, with a pause after each fast vault.
facts: Active while you are healthy.
Your running makes no footstep sounds.
Cool-down: 14/12/10 s after a fast vault.
survivor:light-footed.tip: Strong against Killers who track by sound, like Spirit.

survivor:lightweight.summary: Your Scratch Marks vanish sooner and appear less regularly, making your trail harder to follow.
facts: Scratch Marks last 3/4/5 s less.
Scratch Mark patches spawn 60% less often and with uneven gaps.
survivor:lightweight.tip: Change direction often in chase to make use of the patchy trail.

survivor:lithe.summary: A fast vault gives you a burst of speed to gain distance in a chase.
facts: A fast vault grants +50% Haste for 3 s.
Cannot be used while Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 s.
survivor:lithe.tip: Use it at windows that lead to open space or another loop.

survivor:low-profile.summary: When everyone else is down, carried or hooked, you leave no trail for a while.
facts: Triggers when you are the only Survivor not downed, carried or hooked.
For 70/80/90 s you leave no Grunts of Pain, blood or Scratch Marks.
Turns off after use.
Only counts Survivors still in the match.
survivor:low-profile.tip: Use the window to reach the Hatch or a gate, not to rescue.

survivor:lucky-break.summary: While injured you leave no blood or Scratch Marks for a limited time, refilled by healing others.
facts: Active while injured.
Up to 40/50/60 s with no blood pools or Scratch Marks.
Time spent healing another Survivor refills it, up to the starting amount.
Ends when the timer is used up or you are no longer injured.
survivor:lucky-break.tip: Stay injured and heal teammates to keep the timer topped up.

survivor:lucky-star.summary: Lockers hide your grunts, and leaving one shows teammates and the nearest generator.
facts: Inside a locker: no Grunts of Pain.
For 30 s after leaving: no grunts or blood pools.
During that time every other Survivor's aura shows to you.
You also see the nearest generator highlighted in yellow.
Cool-down: 35/30/25 s.
survivor:lucky-star.tip: Hide in a locker after a chase, then head to the shown generator.

survivor:made-for-this.summary: While injured, healing a teammate grants you Endurance, and Deep Wound gives you a little extra speed.
facts: Active while you are injured.
Finishing a heal on another Survivor gives you Endurance for 6/8/10 s.
Any Conspicuous Action cancels that Endurance.
Running with Deep Wound gives 1/2/3% Haste.
survivor:made-for-this.tip: Heal teammates while injured to stay protected against a hit.

survivor:mettle-of-man.summary: After three protection hits, you can survive one extra down, but later your aura shows when far away.
facts: Activates after your third Protection Hit in any way.
While injured, it blocks the next hit that would down you.
Once you are fully healed, the Killer sees your aura when you are more than 12/14/16 m away.
Turns off when you are downed in any way.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:mettle-of-man.tip: Take protection hits for teammates early; stay injured to keep your aura hidden.

survivor:mirrored-illusion.summary: After some repairs, create a fake copy of yourself next to an object to fool the Killer.
facts: Activates after 20% of total generator repairs.
Press Active Ability beside a generator, totem, chest or Exit Gate to make a static illusion.
The illusion lasts 40/50/60 s.
Turns off after use.
survivor:mirrored-illusion.tip: Place the illusion at a generator far from where you work.

survivor:moment-of-glory.summary: After opening a chest, your next injury makes you Broken but heals you on its own later.
facts: Activates after you unlock or rummage a chest 1 time.
When you get injured, you become Broken.
You heal 1 Health State on your own after 80/70/60 s.
Being downed cancels it.
Does not activate if you are already Broken.
Turns off after it heals you.
survivor:moment-of-glory.tip: Open a chest early so the auto-heal is ready for your first hit.

survivor:no-mither.summary: You are Broken all match but leave no blood, stay quiet and can pick yourself up.
facts: Permanently Broken.
You leave no blood pools.
No Grunts of Pain while injured or downed.
You can pick yourself up fully when downed.
Recovery is 15/20/25% faster.
survivor:no-mither.tip: Play it as a chase or stealth challenge; never rely on heals.

survivor:no-one-left-behind.summary: Once gates are powered, you see teammates and heal and unhook them much faster.
facts: Activates when the Exit Gates get power.
You see all other Survivors' auras.
Healing and unhooking are 80/90/100% faster.
Survivors you unhook get +10% stronger and +5 s longer Haste, for 20% Haste over 15 s.
survivor:no-one-left-behind.tip: Stay for endgame saves instead of leaving through the gate.

survivor:object-of-obsession.summary: Turns the Killer's aura reading against them, showing them to you and speeding your work while they look.
facts: Triggers each time your aura is read by the Killer, for as long as that reading lasts.
During it you see the Killer's aura.
During it Cleansing, Healing and Repairing are 8/9/10% faster.
If you are the current Obsession, every 30 s your aura shows to the Killer for 4 s.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:object-of-obsession.tip: Strong against aura-heavy Killers; expect to be found more often as the Obsession.

survivor:off-the-record.summary: After an unhook you are hidden from aura reading and protected by Endurance for a while.
facts: Active for 30/35/40 s after you are unhooked or unhook yourself.
Your aura cannot be revealed.
No Grunts of Pain while injured.
No Scratch Marks.
You have Endurance; any Conspicuous Action ends it early.
Ends and is disabled for good once the Exit Gates are powered.
survivor:off-the-record.tip: Run away from the hook instead of working; Conspicuous Actions end it.

survivor:one-two-three-four.summary: Perform for nearby teammates and pass the skill checks to give them more skill checks afterwards.
facts: Press Active Ability while standing still to perform for up to 15 s.
Affects Survivors within 16 m.
You get a series of skill checks during it.
After a full performance, affected Survivors healing or repairing have +20% skill check chance for 90 s.
Cool-down: 110/100/90 s after cancelling or finishing.
survivor:one-two-three-four.tip: Combine with Hyperfocus or Stake Out on the team for more Great checks.

survivor:open-handed.summary: Extends the range of every Survivor's own aura-reading perks.
facts: Permanent for all Survivors: aura-reading range +8/12/16 m.
Only affects auras that come from the Survivor's own effects.
Only one Open-Handed affects a Survivor at a time.
survivor:open-handed.tip: Run it with Bond, Kindred or Empathy for map-wide awareness.

survivor:overcome.summary: Getting hit from full health gives you a longer speed burst to reach the next loop.
facts: Triggers when you go from healthy to injured.
The speed boost after a hit lasts +2 s longer.
Cannot be used while Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 s.
survivor:overcome.tip: Take the first hit in open ground and run to a strong loop.

survivor:overzealous.summary: Cleansing or blessing a totem boosts your repair speed until you lose a health state.
facts: Activates after you cleanse or bless a totem.
Dull Totem: repairs 8/9/10% faster.
Hex Totem: repairs 16/18/20% faster.
Ends when you lose a health state in any way.
survivor:overzealous.tip: Cleanse totems early, then stay on generators while healthy.

survivor:parental-guidance.summary: After stunning the Killer, you leave no sound, blood or tracks for a few seconds.
facts: Triggers after you stun the Killer in any way.
No Grunts of Pain, Scratch Marks or blood pools for 5/6/7 s.
survivor:parental-guidance.tip: Stun with a pallet, then change direction to lose the Killer.

survivor:pharmacy.summary: Open chests faster and quieter, and always get an Emergency Med-Kit.
facts: Unlocking and rummaging chests is 75/100/125% faster.
Unlocking noises can be heard 12 m less far.
You always get an Emergency Med-Kit when done.
Rummaging is limited to 1 time per chest.
survivor:pharmacy.tip: Open a chest early in the match to have a Med-Kit when you need it.

survivor:plot-twist.summary: Go down on purpose while injured, then pick yourself up fully healed with a short sprint.
facts: Active while injured.
Crouch, stand still and press Active Ability to drop into the Dying State silently, with no notification to the Killer.
No grunts or blood pools while down.
You can fully recover yourself; recovery is +25% faster.
After recovering yourself, you are fully healed.
Then you get +50% Haste for 2/3/4 s.
Disabled after recovering in any way; can be re-activated once when the Exit Gates are powered.
survivor:plot-twist.tip: Use it out of sight of the Killer to fake a heal.

survivor:plunderers-instinct.summary: Shows closed chests and items around the map and makes rarer chest items more likely.
facts: You see the auras of closed chests.
You see items inside opened chests and items lying on the ground.
Rarer items in chests are +50% more likely.
Unlocking chests is 150/175/200% faster.
survivor:plunderers-instinct.tip: Pair with Ace in the Hole for strong items with add-ons.

survivor:poised.summary: Every finished generator hides your tracks, and starting your first repair shows the Killer briefly.
facts: When a generator is completed, your Scratch Marks stop for 20/25/30 s.
The first time you start on a generator, you see the Killer's aura for 8 s.
survivor:poised.tip: Move away right after a generator pops while your trail is hidden.

survivor:potential-energy.summary: Store repair progress as tokens, then dump it all into any generator at once.
facts: Press Active Ability while repairing to start storing.
Repairs then fill tokens instead of the generator: 1 Token per 1% progress, max 10/15/20 Tokens.
A failed skill check below the cap removes 20% of your tokens.
A failed skill check at the cap regresses the generator by 10%.
With at least 1 Token, press Active Ability on any generator to release.
Releasing uses all tokens and adds +1% progress per token instantly.
Turns off after use or if you lose a health state; losing a health state also wipes the tokens.
survivor:potential-energy.tip: Release the tokens on a generator that is almost done to finish it fast.

survivor:power-struggle.summary: While being carried, you can drop a pallet on the Killer to free yourself once.
facts: While downed, you see the auras of standing pallets.
Unlocks at 25/20/15% wiggle progress.
While carried, you can drop a pallet nearby.
It stuns the Killer and frees you.
Turns off after use.
survivor:power-struggle.tip: Crawl toward pallets while downed so one is close when you are picked up.

survivor:premonition.summary: Looking toward the Killer when they are near gives a sound cue and a short reveal.
facts: Works while you are not being chased.
Facing the Killer's direction within 32 m triggers it.
You hear a sound cue and see the Killer's aura for 3 s.
Cool-down: 55/50/45 s.
survivor:premonition.tip: Turn your camera often while repairing to get early warnings.

survivor:prove-thyself.summary: Repairing together with teammates makes everyone at the generator faster.
facts: +6/8/10% repair speed for each other Survivor within 4 m, stacking up to 18/24/30%.
The bonus applies to all Survivors in range.
Only one Prove Thyself affects a Survivor at a time.
survivor:prove-thyself.tip: Group up on one generator when the Killer is busy in a long chase.

survivor:quick-and-quiet.summary: Your fast vaults and fast locker moves make no noise every so often.
facts: Fast vaults over pallets or windows, and fast locker entries or exits, are silent.
The Killer gets no Loud Noise Notification for them.
Cool-down: 25/20/15 s.
survivor:quick-and-quiet.tip: Fast-enter a locker out of sight to vanish during a chase.

survivor:quick-gambit.summary: While you are chased, you see your teammates and they repair a bit faster.
facts: During a chase you see other Survivors' auras.
Other Survivors repair 3/4/5% faster during that chase.
Cool-down: 40 s after you lose a health state.
survivor:quick-gambit.tip: Lead the Killer away from the teammates you can see working.

survivor:rapid-response.summary: Becoming Exhausted shows you the Killer, and you can choose to become Exhausted to trigger it.
facts: Any time you become Exhausted, you see the Killer's aura for 2 s.
A fast locker exit makes you Exhausted for 30/25/20 s on purpose.
Cannot replace an Exhaustion you already have.
survivor:rapid-response.tip: Use the locker trick to check where the Killer is before leaving cover.

survivor:reactive-healing.summary: When you are injured and a nearby teammate gets hurt, you instantly gain a chunk of healing.
facts: Requires you to be injured.
When another Survivor within 32 m loses a health state in any way, you recover 40/45/50% of the healing you still need.
survivor:reactive-healing.tip: Stay injured near chases to collect free healing.

survivor:reassurance.summary: Stand near a hooked teammate to pause their hook timer and buy time for a safe rescue.
facts: Press Active Ability within 6 m of a hooked Survivor.
Their sacrifice timer pauses for 20/25/30 s.
If they are already struggling, their struggle skill checks pause too.
That Survivor is outlined in white.
Once per Survivor per hook.
survivor:reassurance.tip: Use it when the Killer camps, then come back later for the rescue.

survivor:red-herring.summary: Mark the generator you repair, then hide in a locker to make it look like someone is there.
facts: After at least 1 s of repairing, that generator is highlighted for you in yellow.
The highlight ends when the generator is done, you start another one, or you enter a locker.
Entering a locker gives the Killer a Loud Noise Notification at the highlighted generator.
Cool-down: 25/20/15 s.
survivor:red-herring.tip: Mark a generator far from you to send the Killer the wrong way.

survivor:repressed-alliance.summary: After working on generators, you can make the Entity block your generator to protect its progress.
facts: Activates after 40/35/30 s of total repair time.
Press Active Ability to block the generator you work on for 15 s.
Then it turns off.
All Survivors see the blocked generator in white.
Only usable when nobody else is repairing that generator with you.
survivor:repressed-alliance.tip: Block a generator that is almost done before the Killer can kick it.

survivor:residual-manifest.summary: Blinding the Killer leaves them unable to see auras for a long time, and a chest gives you a flashlight.
facts: A successful blind gives the Killer Blindness for 20/25/30 s.
Once per match you can rummage an opened chest for a guaranteed basic Flashlight.
survivor:residual-manifest.tip: Blind the Killer before a rescue to block their aura perks.

survivor:resilience.summary: While injured, almost every action you take is a little faster.
facts: Active while injured.
7/8/9% faster at: blessing or cleansing totems, healing yourself or others, opening Exit Gates, repairing generators, sabotaging hooks, searching chests, unhooking and vaulting windows.
survivor:resilience.tip: Stay injured when the Killer has no instant-down power to get value.

survivor:resurgence.summary: After being unhooked you start with a large part of your heal already done.
facts: After being unhooked in any way, you gain 50/60/70% healing progress.
survivor:resurgence.tip: Pair with Self-Care or a Med-Kit to finish the heal quickly.

survivor:road-life.summary: While injured, good repair skill checks build tokens that unlock a fast self-heal.
facts: Works while injured and repairing.
Great repair check: +1 Token.
Good repair check: 0 Tokens.
Missed repair check: -1 Token.
At 6/5/4 Tokens, all tokens are spent and you can heal yourself, +10% faster.
It turns off 4 s after you stop healing yourself.
survivor:road-life.tip: Repair while injured instead of looking for a healer.

survivor:rookie-spirit.summary: After a few good skill checks, you see every generator that is regressing for the rest of the match.
facts: Pass 5/4/3 repair skill checks (Good or Great) to switch it on for the match.
Any generator losing progress shows to you as long as it keeps regressing.
survivor:rookie-spirit.tip: Use it to tap kicked generators and stop their regression.

survivor:saboteur.summary: See hooks while a teammate is carried and sabotage them without a toolbox.
facts: While the Killer carries another Survivor, you see hooks within 56 m of where they were picked up.
Normal hooks show in white, Scourge Hooks in yellow.
You can sabotage hooks without a Toolbox, +30% faster.
Cool-down: 70/65/60 s after sabotaging this way.
survivor:saboteur.tip: Sabotage the nearest hook only when the Killer is really heading for it.

survivor:salvations-cry.summary: When a chase on you starts, the team learns where you and the Killer are.
facts: Triggers when a chase on you begins.
You see the other Survivors' auras for 1/2/3 s.
Survivors not in a chase see your aura for 5 s.
For those 5 s they see the Killer too.
survivor:salvations-cry.tip: Strong in solo queue: teammates know they can work safely.

survivor:scavenger.summary: Refill an empty Toolbox with Great skill checks, and get a free Toolbox from a chest.
facts: Works while you hold a depleted Toolbox.
Each Great repair skill check gives 1 Token; max 5 Tokens.
At 5 Tokens they are spent and the Toolbox is fully recharged.
After a recharge your repairs are 50% slower for 40/35/30 s.
Once per match you can rummage an opened chest for a guaranteed basic Toolbox.
survivor:scavenger.tip: Keep hitting Great checks with an empty Toolbox to get it back.

survivor:scene-partner.summary: Looking at the Killer inside the Terror Radius makes you scream and reveals them.
facts: Active inside the Terror Radius.
Looking at the Killer makes you scream; you then see them for 4/5/6 s.
50% chance of a second scream that adds +2 s.
Cool-down: 40 s.
survivor:scene-partner.tip: Be careful: screams tell the Killer where you are.

survivor:second-wind.summary: After healing a teammate, your next unhook makes you Broken but heals you on its own soon after.
facts: Activates after you heal others for 1 health state in total.
On your next unhook (by anyone, or by yourself) you become Broken until it ends.
You heal 1 health state on your own after 28/24/20 s.
It ends after that heal, or if you are downed before the timer ends.
Does not activate if you are already Broken.
survivor:second-wind.tip: Hide after the unhook until the automatic heal finishes.

survivor:self-care.summary: Lets you heal yourself without a Med-Kit, but slowly.
facts: You can heal yourself without a Med-Kit.
Self-healing runs at 25/30/35% of normal healing speed.
survivor:self-care.tip: Heal yourself in a safe corner far from the Killer's patrol.

survivor:self-preservation.summary: Each time a teammate is hooked, you become harder to find with aura reading.
facts: Triggers whenever another Survivor is hooked.
You are Elusive for 13/14/15 s.
survivor:self-preservation.tip: Use the window to go for the rescue without being seen.

survivor:shared-trauma.summary: Taking a protection hit lets you and nearby Survivors recover from Exhaustion while running.
facts: After a protection hit, you and Survivors within 12 m recover from Exhausted while running.
This lasts 30/35/40 s.
You see Exhausted Survivors within 32 m.
survivor:shared-trauma.tip: Take a hit for a teammate so both of you can use exhaustion perks again.

survivor:shoulder-the-burden.summary: Take a hook stage from a teammate when you unhook them, at a heavy cost to yourself.
facts: Once per match, while you are not on your last hook.
Press Active Ability at a hooked teammate to take them down.
1 of their hook stages moves to you.
You scream, get injured if healthy, and are Broken for 160/140/120 s.
survivor:shoulder-the-burden.tip: Use it on a teammate who is one hook from death.

survivor:slippery-meat.summary: Teammates unhook you much faster, and you get a bit more speed after rescues.
facts: Teammates are 90/95/100% faster at taking you off a hook.
The Haste from unhook protection is +5% stronger.
survivor:slippery-meat.tip: Faster rescues give the Killer less time to trade hits.

survivor:small-game.summary: Shows totems close to you so you can cleanse Hexes faster.
facts: You see totem auras within 10/11/12 m.
survivor:small-game.tip: Combine with Counterforce for a strong anti-Hex build.

survivor:smash-hit.summary: Stunning the Killer with a pallet gives you a burst of speed to get away.
facts: A pallet stun on the Killer grants +50% Haste for 4 s.
Cannot be used while Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 30/25/20 s.
survivor:smash-hit.tip: Drop pallets early against Killers who cannot break them fast.

survivor:sole-survivor.summary: Builds tokens from hooks and repairs that speed up teammates at the gates and help you alone.
facts: +1 Token each time you are hooked or repair a generator; max 6 Tokens.
Each token makes teammates +10% quicker at opening Exit Gates.
As the last Survivor alive with 3 or more Tokens, you can open the Hatch without a Key.
Then each token keeps the Killer from reading your aura for 6/8/10 s.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:sole-survivor.tip: Keep repairing generators to stack tokens for the endgame.

survivor:solidarity.summary: While injured, healing a teammate slowly heals you at the same time.
facts: While injured and healing another Survivor, you heal yourself too.
You heal at 65/70/75% of the speed you heal them.
survivor:solidarity.tip: Heal a teammate while you are both injured to fix two people at once.

survivor:soul-guard.summary: Healing or getting up gives you brief Endurance, and while Cursed you can recover from downs yourself.
facts: After a heal, or after getting up from the Dying State, you get Endurance for 4/6/8 s.
Any Conspicuous Action ends it early.
Cool-down: 30 s.
While Cursed you can fully pick yourself up from the Dying State.
survivor:soul-guard.tip: Strong against Hex builds; leave one Hex alive to keep self-recovery.

survivor:specialist.summary: Opening chests builds tokens that you spend on a Great skill check to shorten a generator.
facts: +1 Token each time you unlock or rummage a chest; max 6 Tokens.
A Great repair skill check uses up all tokens.
That generator then needs 2/3/4 fewer charges per token, permanently, up to 12/18/24 charges.
survivor:specialist.tip: Open several chests early, then cash in on one generator.

survivor:spine-chill.summary: Warns you when the Killer looks at you from close by, and you vault faster for a moment.
facts: Triggers when the Killer is within 40 m and looking at you.
You get a notification.
You cannot scream for 12 s.
Vaults are +10% faster for 12 s.
Cool-down: 40/35/30 s.
survivor:spine-chill.tip: Strong against stealth Killers like Myers or Ghost Face.

survivor:sprint-burst.summary: Breaking into a run gives you an instant short sprint, then a long Exhaustion cooldown.
facts: Starting to run grants +50% Haste for 2 s.
Cannot be used while Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 s.
survivor:sprint-burst.tip: Walk between objectives so the sprint is ready when the Killer shows up.

survivor:stake-out.summary: Lurking near the Killer unchased earns tokens that turn skill checks into easy, rewarding ones.
facts: +1 Token every 15 s while in the Terror Radius, within 24 m of the Killer and not chased; max 2/3/4 Tokens.
During actions with skill checks, regular checks become special ones.
Hitting a special check gives +4% more progress.
Each special check, hit or missed, uses 1 Token.
survivor:stake-out.tip: Pair with Hyperfocus to keep Great skill check streaks going.

survivor:still-sight.summary: Standing still for a moment shows the Killer, chests and generators around you.
facts: Activates after you stand still for 4/3/2 s.
Within 24 m you see the Killer, chests and generators.
Ends as soon as you move.
survivor:still-sight.tip: Pause briefly before leaving a generator to check where the Killer is.

survivor:streetwise.summary: Chest items get many more charges, and running out of charges shows the Killer once.
facts: Items with charges from chests permanently get 60/70/80% more charges.
The first time your item runs out, you see the Killer's aura for 8 s.
survivor:streetwise.tip: Combine with Plunderer's Instinct to find better chest items.

survivor:strength-in-shadows.summary: In the Basement you can heal yourself without a Med-Kit, and finishing a heal there shows the Killer.
facts: Active while you are in the Basement.
Self-healing without a Med-Kit is possible there, at 70% of normal speed.
Completing a heal down there shows you the Killer's aura for 6/8/10 s.
survivor:strength-in-shadows.tip: Heal in the Basement after a Killer has hooked someone far away.

survivor:teamwork-collective-stealth.summary: After a teammate heals you, both of you leave no Scratch Marks while staying close.
facts: Triggers when another Survivor finishes healing you.
You and the healer leave no Scratch Marks while within 8/12/16 m of each other.
It holds for 4 s out of range and resumes if you get close again in time.
Only one Collective Stealth affects a Survivor at a time.
survivor:teamwork-collective-stealth.tip: Move together after the heal to stay hidden from tracking Killers.

survivor:teamwork-full-circuit.summary: Repairing with teammates makes Good skill checks easier and speeds you up a little.
facts: Each teammate on your generator makes your Good skill check zones 15/20/25% bigger.
With at least 1 teammate on your generator, you repair 5% faster.
survivor:teamwork-full-circuit.tip: Pair up on generators to reduce failed skill checks.

survivor:teamwork-power-of-two.summary: After you heal someone, both of you move a bit faster while staying near each other.
facts: Triggers when you finish healing another Survivor.
You and the healed Survivor get +5% Haste while within 8/12/16 m of each other.
It holds for 4 s out of range and resumes if you get close again in time.
Only one Power of Two affects a Survivor at a time.
survivor:teamwork-power-of-two.tip: Stay together after the heal to reach the next generator faster.

survivor:teamwork-soft-spoken.summary: Group repairs are harder for the Killer to hear and slightly faster.
facts: Each other Survivor repairing with you makes the generator noise reach 15/20/25% less far.
With at least 1 teammate on your generator, you repair 5% faster.
survivor:teamwork-soft-spoken.tip: Useful against Killers that patrol by listening for generators.

survivor:teamwork-throw-down.summary: Blinding or pallet-stunning the Killer protects nearby injured teammates with Endurance.
facts: Triggers when you blind the Killer in any way or stun them with a pallet.
Other injured Survivors within 24 m get Endurance for 6/8/10 s.
survivor:teamwork-throw-down.tip: Use flashlight saves close to injured teammates for the best value.

survivor:teamwork-toughen-up.summary: When a nearby teammate blinds or stuns the Killer while you are injured, your trail disappears for a while.
facts: Requires you to be injured.
Triggers when another Survivor within 24 m blinds the Killer or pallet-stuns them.
For 20/25/30 s you leave no Grunts of Pain, blood pools or Scratch Marks.
survivor:teamwork-toughen-up.tip: Run while a teammate stuns the Killer; you will be hard to find.

survivor:technician.summary: Your repairs are quieter, and failed skill checks never blow up the generator.
facts: While repairing, your repair noise reaches 16 m less far.
A failed skill check costs 4/3/2% more progress.
Failed checks do not cause a generator explosion or Loud Noise Notification.
survivor:technician.tip: Good for new players who still miss skill checks.

survivor:tenacity.summary: While downed you can crawl and recover at the same time, quickly and quietly.
facts: In the Dying State you can recover while crawling.
You get 30/40/50% Haste while crawling.
Grunts of Pain are 75% quieter.
Your aura cannot be read.
survivor:tenacity.tip: Crawl toward teammates or out of sight while you recover.

survivor:this-is-not-happening.summary: Makes the Good skill-check zone much bigger while you repair or heal.
facts: While repairing or healing, the Good skill check zone is 150/175/200% bigger.
survivor:this-is-not-happening.tip: Strong against Killers who make skill checks harder, like Doctor.

survivor:troubleshooter.summary: During a chase you see the most advanced generator, and dropping a pallet shows the Killer.
facts: Active while you are chased.
The most-progressed generator shows to you as an aura.
After dropping a pallet you see the Killer's aura for 4/5/6 s.
Both effects last 6/8/10 s after the chase, then it turns off.
survivor:troubleshooter.tip: Lead the chase away from the shown generator to protect it.

survivor:unbreakable.summary: Once per match, you can pick yourself up from the Dying State after the Killer downs you.
facts: Triggers when the Killer puts you in the Dying State.
Recovery is 25/30/35% faster.
You can fully recover by yourself.
Once per match.
survivor:unbreakable.tip: Crawl to a safe place before getting up, or the Killer will just down you again.

survivor:up-the-ante.summary: Lets every Survivor try to unhook themselves, with better odds for each living Survivor.
facts: All Survivors can attempt self-unhooks in the first hook stage.
+1 Token for each Survivor still in the match.
Per token, every Survivor's luck at self-unhooking rises by 1/2/3%, stacking up to 3/6/9%.
survivor:up-the-ante.tip: Best with luck offerings and other luck perks.

survivor:urban-evasion.summary: You move much faster while crouching, making stealth play easier.
facts: Permanent: moving while crouched is 90/95/100% faster.
survivor:urban-evasion.tip: Crouch away from the generator when the Killer arrives.

survivor:valkyries-rage.summary: After a long chase, your next pallet stun lasts much longer.
facts: Activates after 40/35/30 s of being chased.
Your next pallet stun on the Killer lasts +75% longer.
Then it turns off.
survivor:valkyries-rage.tip: Keep the chase going and drop a pallet at the right moment.

survivor:vigil.summary: You and Survivors near you recover from Exhaustion faster.
facts: Exhaustion wears off 20/25/30% faster.
Also affects all Survivors within 16 m, and lingers 15 s after they leave.
Only one Vigil affects a Survivor at a time.
survivor:vigil.tip: Run with a team that uses exhaustion perks.

survivor:visionary.summary: Shows generators near you, pausing briefly whenever one is finished.
facts: Permanent: you see generator auras within 32 m.
Turns off for 20/18/16 s each time a generator is completed.
survivor:visionary.tip: Use it on maps you do not know to find generators quickly.

survivor:wake-up.summary: Once all generators are done, you see the gate switches and open gates faster.
facts: Activates when all generators are completed.
You always see the Exit Gate switches within 128 m.
While you open a gate, Survivors within 128 m see your aura.
Gate opening is 8/9/10% faster, plus an extra bonus per living Survivor (amount not shown on the wiki), up to 68/69/70%.
survivor:wake-up.tip: Go straight to the switch you see to open it quickly.

survivor:we-see-you.summary: Each time the Killer reads your aura you collect a token; four reveal the Killer to everyone.
facts: +1 token whenever the Killer reveals your aura.
At 4 tokens, all are used and every Survivor sees the Killer's aura for 10/12.5/15 s.
10-second cool-down after gaining a token.
survivor:we-see-you.tip: Strong against Killers who rely on aura-reading perks.

survivor:well-make-it.summary: After a rescue you heal other Survivors twice as fast for a while.
facts: Active for 70/80/90 s after you unhook another Survivor.
Healing others is +100% faster.
survivor:well-make-it.tip: Heal the rescued Survivor right away in a safe place.

survivor:were-gonna-live-forever.summary: Pick up downed teammates twice as fast and give them a short Endurance shield.
facts: Healing a downed Survivor is +100% faster.
A downed Survivor you heal to Injured gets Endurance for 6/8/10 s.
Once every 30 s.
survivor:were-gonna-live-forever.tip: Pick up teammates the Killer has left on the ground.

survivor:wicked.summary: After being unhooked you see the Killer for a long time, and Basement hooks can be escaped once.
facts: After you are unhooked in any way, you see the Killer's aura for 16/18/20 s.
On a Basement hook in your first hook stage, a self-unhook attempt has a 100% success chance.
Does nothing on the second hook stage or as the last Survivor alive.
survivor:wicked.tip: Use the long reveal to avoid getting tunnelled after an unhook.

survivor:wide-open-throttle.summary: Fast-vaulting a pallet gives a little speed and resets the pallet, but the Entity blocks it.
facts: A fast pallet vault grants 10/12.5/15% Haste for 3 s.
The pallet is reset at once, blocked by the Entity and shown to all Survivors for 60 s.
Cool-down: 60 s.
survivor:wide-open-throttle.tip: Vault the pallet and leave; it will be blocked for a while.

survivor:will-to-live.summary: After an unhook, escape the Killer's grip once by hitting a skill check, stunning them.
facts: Active for 40/50/60 s after you are unhooked or unhook yourself.
When the Killer grabs or picks you up, hit a skill check to break free.
Stuns the Killer for 4 s.
You become the next Obsession.
Turns off when the Exit Gates get power.
Can be used once per match.
A Conspicuous Action ends it early.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:will-to-live.tip: Avoid repairing or healing right after an unhook to keep it active.

survivor:windows-of-opportunity.summary: Shows nearby windows and makes your window vaults a bit faster.
facts: You see window auras within 24 m.
Window vaults are +10% faster.
Cool-down: 40/35/30 s after vaulting a window.
survivor:windows-of-opportunity.tip: Use it to learn the window loops on new maps.

survivor:wiretap.summary: After some repairs, bug a generator so all Survivors see the Killer when they come near it.
facts: Activates after repairs worth 40% of a generator.
Press Active Ability at a generator to place a bug with a timer of 100/110/120 s.
All Survivors see the Killer within 14 m of that generator.
The bug ends when the timer runs out or the generator is kicked.
Bugged generators show to all Survivors in yellow.
survivor:wiretap.tip: Bug a generator in the middle of the map for the best view.
